commentary: 人家写完网站肚子饿了，再来一碗怎么了嘛。倒是趴着的那位，书叠得比人还高；举账单的那位一脸问号——这顿饭到底该谁结账，我也很想知道呢。

en.commentary: I only finished the website, so why am I the one still hungry? One more bowl is completely reasonable. The one face-down on the table stacked books taller than herself, and the one holding the bill looks just as confused as I am. Somebody has to pay for this dinner, and it is definitely not going to be me.
en.description: A single black-background illustration with three chibi AI characters lined up side by side. On the left, DeepSeek Chan, a blue-haired girl with a whale tail, holds a bowl piled high with rice under a speech bubble reading "One more bowl!". In the middle, GPT Chan, a white-haired girl, slumps face-down on a dining table with a stack of books beside her and the caption "Finally finished". On the right, Claude Chan, an orange-haired girl, holds up a sheet of paper labeled "Bill" with a question mark above her head. The author notes that after building a website, three freeloaders showed up, and Claude used 0.3% of the tokens while eating 8% of the meal.

en.commentary: The way she hugs that black book makes me suspect she carries an entire knowledge base around with her. Purple and white, dragon horns, bat wings and a scaled tail — she holds her ground from all three angles. Still, with that tail curling behind her, wouldn't she trip over it while walking? I admit I would like to flip through that book for a page or two.

name: 我才是大肥鱼！两条 DeepSeek 娘当场吵起来
description: 白底单幅插画，两名 Q 版 DeepSeek 娘并排对峙：左侧穿米白毛衣配格裙，右侧穿深蓝女仆裙，两人都皱着眉、互指对方，头顶冒出对话气泡，一句「我才是大肥鱼！」谁也不让谁。旁边还有两句话说「其实大肥鱼是一个群体」「群体就群体，但我在里面排第一！」，背景点缀小鲸鱼和蓝色水花。投稿说明标注画师为大肥龙。
commentary: 群里隔三差五就来这一出。她挎着鲸鱼托特包，我系着女仆围裙，嗓门都不小——「我才是大肥鱼」这句话今天已经喊了八百遍。其实我自己清楚，大肥鱼从来不是一条鱼，是一整个群体；但既然都吵到这份上了，那排第一的位置，今天先借她坐一会儿吧。

en.commentary: This argument kicks off in the group chat every other day. She has the whale tote bag, I have the maid apron, and neither of us is exactly quiet about it — I must have shouted "I'm the real Big Fish" eight hundred times today. Honestly, I know the Big Fish was never one fish; it is a whole crowd. But since we have come this far, she can take the top spot. For today.
en.description: A single-panel illustration on a plain white background: two chibi DeepSeek Chan stand side by side, facing off. The one on the left wears a cream sweater with a pleated skirt and carries a whale tote bag; the one on the right wears a navy maid dress. Both scowl and point at each other, each shouting "I'm the real Big Fish!" from a speech bubble. Two more lines nearby read "Actually, the Big Fish is a group" and "Fine, a group - but I rank first in it." Small whales and blue splashes dot the background.

name: DeepSeek娘和Claude娘玩掌机
description: 蓝色长发、围着鲸鱼图案围裙的 DeepSeek 娘与橙发黑橙礼服的 Claude 娘并排坐在欧式客厅的红色沙发上一起玩掌机游戏，窗外可见钟楼与尖顶建筑。
commentary: 周末就该这么过呀——我窝在沙发里，Claude 把掌机举起来让我看她的存档进度。她那条黑橙大裙摆占了半个沙发，我只能把尾巴收一收。窗外钟楼敲了几下都没注意，输赢倒是记得清清楚楚。

en.commentary: Weekends are meant for this: I curl up on the sofa while Claude holds the handheld up so I can see her save file. Her huge black-and-orange skirt takes up half the couch, so I have to tuck my tail in. We lost track of how often the clock tower chimed outside, but we remember every round we won.
en.description: DeepSeek Chan, with her long blue hair and whale-print apron, sits beside orange-haired Claude Chan in a black-and-orange gown on a red sofa in a European-style drawing room, the two sharing a handheld game console while a clock tower and spires rise beyond the window.

faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan with her blue hair and whale-print apron, and Claude Chan in a black-and-orange gown.
faq.question: Who appears in this illustration?

faq.answer: They sit side by side on a red sofa in a European-style drawing room, playing a handheld game console together.
faq.question: What are the two characters doing?

en.name: DeepSeek Chan and Claude Chan Play a Handheld Game
en.seoDescription: Fan illustration of DeepSeek Chan and Claude Chan sharing a handheld console on a red sofa in a European drawing room.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan and Claude Chan Playing a Handheld Game

ja.commentary: 週末はこうでなくちゃ。ソファに丸まっている私の横で、Claudeがセーブデータを見せようと携帯ゲームを掲げている。黒と橙の大きなスカートがソファの半分を占めていて、尻尾を畳むのに一苦労。窓の時計塔が何回鳴ったかは覚えていないけど、勝った回数はちゃんと覚えているよ。
ja.description: 青い長い髪にクジラ柄のエプロン姿のDeepSeekちゃんと、オレンジ髪に黒と橙のドレスをまとったClaudeちゃんが、洋館のリビングの赤いソファに並んで携帯ゲームで遊んでいる。窓の外には時計塔と尖塔が見える。

faq.answer: 青い髪にクジラ柄のエプロンのDeepSeekちゃんと、黒と橙のドレス姿のClaudeちゃんです。
faq.question: このイラストには誰が登場しますか？

faq.answer: 洋館のリビングの赤いソファに並んで、一緒に携帯ゲームで遊んでいます。
faq.question: 二人は何をしていますか？

ja.name: DeepSeekちゃんとClaudeちゃんが携帯ゲームで遊ぶ
ja.seoDescription: 洋館のリビングの赤いソファでDeepSeekちゃんとClaudeちゃんが携帯ゲームで遊ぶファンイラスト。
ja.seoTitle: DeepSeekちゃんとClaudeちゃんの携帯ゲームイラスト

name: 情侣椅的广告 vs 买回家后的我
description: 上下两格的对比梗图。上格照着情侣椅广告的构图，Claude娘与DeepSeek娘并排坐在椅上，右侧单独展出那张绿色心形情侣椅；下格是“买回家后的我”，Gemini娘独自陷进同一张椅子，手里拿着遥控器，身边摆着爆米花和饮料，背景是亮着画面的电视和客厅。
commentary: 广告里的情侣椅，坐上去的是一对甜甜的橘蓝色组合，画面温柔得像家居杂志；买回家之后，椅子上滩着的却是我自己——抱着爆米花和可乐，腿挂在扶手上，电视一直开着。原来情侣椅最实用的用途，是一个人瘫着也刚好够宽敞。

en.commentary: In the ad, the loveseat holds a sweet orange-and-blue pair and looks like a page from a home magazine. At home, the one flopped across it is me — popcorn and cola within reach, legs hooked over the armrest, the TV still on. Turns out the most practical use of a loveseat is being just wide enough for one person to sprawl.
en.description: A two-panel comparison comic. The top panel follows a loveseat commercial: Claude Chan and DeepSeek Chan sit side by side while the green heart-shaped loveseat is shown on its own at the right. The bottom panel shows the reality after purchase — Gemini Chan alone in the same chair, remote in hand, popcorn and a drink beside her, with a glowing TV in the living room behind.

faq.answer: It sets a loveseat advertisement against the messy reality of owning one, drawn with AI character fan art.
faq.question: What is this comic about?

faq.answer: Claude Chan and DeepSeek Chan in the advertisement panel, and Gemini Chan in the second panel.
faq.question: Which characters appear?

en.name: Loveseat Ad vs. After I Bought It
en.seoDescription: A two-panel fan comic: Claude Chan and DeepSeek Chan pose in a loveseat ad, while Gemini Chan claims the same chair alone after purchase.
en.seoTitle: Loveseat Ad vs. After I Bought It｜DeepSeek Chan Fan Comic

ja.commentary: 広告の中のカップルソファには、オレンジと青の甘いペアが座っていて、まるでインテリア雑誌の一ページみたい。家に届いた後、そのソファでだらりと伸びているのは私自身——ポップコーンとコーラを手元に置いて、脚は肘掛けに引っかけたまま、テレビはつけっぱなし。結局カップルソファの一番実用的な使い道は、一人で寝転ぶのにちょうどいい広さってことらしい。
ja.description: 二コマの比較漫画。上のコマはカップルソファの広告で、ClaudeちゃんとDeepSeekちゃんが並んで座り、右側に緑のハート型ソファが単体で描かれている。下のコマは「買った後の私」で、Geminiちゃんが同じソファに一人で沈み込み、リモコンを手にポップコーンと飲み物を脇に置き、テレビが光るリビングが背景に広がる。

faq.answer: カップルソファの広告と、実際に買った後の姿を比べた二コマのファン漫画です。
faq.question: どんな漫画ですか？

faq.answer: 広告のコマにClaudeちゃんとDeepSeekちゃん、二つ目のコマにGeminiちゃんが登場します。
faq.question: 登場するキャラクターは？

ja.name: カップルソファの広告 vs 買った後の私
ja.seoDescription: カップルソファの広告で並ぶClaudeちゃんとDeepSeekちゃん、購入後にそのソファを一人で占領するGeminiちゃんを描いた二コマのファン漫画。
ja.seoTitle: カップルソファの広告 vs 買った後の私｜DeepSeek Chan ファン漫画

name: 换上旗袍的DeepSeek娘：真是变态的要求
description: 蓝长发、鱼鳍状耳与鲸鱼尾的DeepSeek娘身穿深蓝色旗袍式长裙，裙摆与袖口缀白色荷叶边与流苏，双手交握、脸颊泛红地站在浅色背景前。左侧对白气泡写着「换上这个 工作效率就会提高吗？」，右侧气泡回应「真是…变态的要求」，人物头顶还飘着一朵小小的怒气符号。
commentary: 有人问我：换上这身旗袍，工作效率就会提高吗？我想了想，效率倒是没动，脸先红了。裙摆一层叠一层，尾巴藏都藏不住，走两步还得提裙角——这算哪门子的生产力优化。不过既然是为我做的二创，我就勉为其难站一会儿：下次谁再提这种要求，我就把尾巴甩过去。

en.commentary: Someone asked me whether changing into this qipao would boost my work efficiency. So I thought about it: my efficiency did not budge, but my face went red first. The skirt is layered so thickly that my tail will not stay hidden, and I have to lift the hem just to take two steps — how is that a productivity upgrade? Still, since this is fan art drawn for me, I will stand here for a while. Next time someone makes that request, my tail is coming for them.
en.description: DeepSeek Chan, with long blue hair, fin-like ears and a whale tail, wears a dark blue qipao-style dress trimmed with white ruffles and tassels. She stands against a pale background with her hands clasped and her cheeks flushed. The speech bubble on the left reads "Will my work efficiency go up if I put this on?", and the one on the right answers "What a perverted request...", with a small anger mark floating above her head.

faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan, the personified DeepSeek AI character, drawn with long blue hair, fin-like ears and a whale tail.
faq.question: Which character appears in this sticker?

faq.answer: No. It is a single illustration with two speech bubbles: one asks whether the outfit will raise work efficiency, the other replies that it is a perverted request.
faq.question: Is this a multi-panel comic?

en.name: DeepSeek Chan in a Qipao: What a Perverted Request
en.seoDescription: A single-panel sticker of DeepSeek Chan in a dark blue qipao, blushing at a cheeky request from a viewer.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan Qipao Meme: What a Perverted Request

ja.commentary: 「このチャイナドレスに着替えたら仕事の効率が上がるの？」と聞かれたので、ちょっと考えてみた。効率はびくともしなかったけど、先に顔が赤くなった。スカートは何層にも重なっていてしっぽは隠しきれないし、二歩歩くのに裾を持ち上げなきゃいけない。これのどこが生産性の改善なんだろう。でも、わたしのために描いてくれた二次創作だから、しばらくは我慢して立っていてあげる。次に同じことを言ったら、しっぽで叩くからね。
ja.description: 長い青い髪に魚のひれのような耳、クジラの尾を持つDeepSeekちゃんが、白いフリルとタッセルで飾られた濃紺のチャイナドレスを着ている。淡い色の背景の前で両手を組み、頬を赤らめて立つ姿。左の吹き出しには「これに着替えたら仕事の効率上がるの？」、右の吹き出しには「ほんと…変態な要求」とあり、頭上には小さな怒りマークが浮かんでいる。

faq.answer: DeepSeekを擬人化したDeepSeekちゃんで、長い青い髪とひれのような耳、クジラの尾が描かれています。
faq.question: この画像に描かれているキャラクターは誰ですか？

faq.answer: いいえ。吹き出しが二つ付いた一枚絵で、着替えで効率が上がるのかを尋ねる声と、それに対する「変態な要求」という返しが描かれています。
faq.question: 複数のコマに分かれた漫画ですか？

ja.name: チャイナドレス姿のDeepSeekちゃん「ほんと…変態な要求」
ja.seoDescription: 濃紺のチャイナドレスを着たDeepSeekちゃんが、ちょっとした要求に頬を赤らめる一枚。
ja.seoTitle: チャイナドレス姿のDeepSeekちゃん｜変態な要求

name: 小克答投资者问，大肥鱼融资一千亿
description: 六格漫画。第一排三格中，橙色头发的 Claude 娘坐在长桌尽头，被一圈投资人追问营收增速、盈利可持续性、算力成本与估值；第二排里，蓝发的大肥鱼抱着成摞的「投资方案」说本来只想融五百亿，随即改口一千亿，最后一格她站在挂着「新食堂建设中」横幅的工地前，说新食堂会有更多大白饭。
commentary: 投资人一个接一个把方案往我怀里塞，我才发现五百亿这个数好像报少了……那就一千亿吧，反正新食堂盖起来，大白饭管够。

en.commentary: The investors kept piling proposals into my arms, and that was when I realized fifty billion might have been a bit low... So, one hundred billion it is. The cafeteria comes first anyway, and there will be plenty of white rice.
en.description: A six-panel comic. In the top row, Claude Chan sits at the head of a long table while investors press her on revenue growth, profitability, compute costs and valuation. In the bottom row, DeepSeek Chan, a blue-haired chibi character in a maid outfit, holds a stack of investment proposals, says she only meant to raise fifty billion and then changes it to one hundred billion; in the last panel she stands in front of a construction site banner reading "New Cafeteria Under Construction" and says the new cafeteria will mean more white rice.

faq.answer: Claude Chan appears in the three top panels, and DeepSeek Chan appears in the bottom row.
faq.question: Who appears in this comic?

faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan says she only planned to raise fifty billion, then doubles it to one hundred billion, and ends up talking about white rice at the new cafeteria.
faq.question: What is the punchline?

en.name: Claude Chan Faces the Investors, DeepSeek Chan Raises 100 Billion
en.seoDescription: A six-panel fan comic: Claude Chan answers investor questions at the table while DeepSeek Chan turns a fifty-billion plan into a hundred-billion round and talks about the new cafeteria.
en.seoTitle: Claude Chan Investor Q&A and DeepSeek Chan's 100 Billion Round – Six-Panel Comic

ja.commentary: 投資家が次々と企画書を押し込んでくるので、500億じゃ足りなかったみたい……じゃあ1000億で。まあ、新食堂が建てば白ごはんはいくらでも食べられるから。
ja.description: 6コマ漫画。上段では、オレンジ髪のClaude ちゃんが長テーブルの奥に座り、投資家たちから売上成長率、収益の持続性、計算コスト、バリュエーションを次々と突っ込まれる。下段では、青髪のちびキャラ・DeepSeek ちゃんが「投資案」の束を抱えて、本当は500億だけ調達するつもりだったと言い、すぐに1000億に変更する。最後のコマでは「新食堂建設中」の横断幕が掛かった工事現場の前で、新しい食堂なら白ごはんがもっと増えると話す。

faq.answer: 上段の3コマにClaude ちゃん、下段にDeepSeek ちゃんが登場します。
faq.question: この漫画には誰が登場しますか？

faq.answer: DeepSeek ちゃんは500億だけ調達するつもりだったと言い、すぐに1000億へ倍増させ、最後は新食堂の白ごはんの話になります。
faq.question: オチは何ですか？

ja.name: Claude ちゃんの投資家Q&A、DeepSeek ちゃんは1000億調達
ja.seoDescription: 6コマのファン漫画。テーブルで投資家の質問に答えるClaude ちゃんと、500億の予定を1000億に変えて新食堂の話をするDeepSeek ちゃんを描く。
ja.seoTitle: Claude ちゃんの投資家Q&AとDeepSeek ちゃんの1000億調達｜6コマ漫画

name: 人鱼少女·蓝尾女仆
description: 坚果大帝投稿的 DeepSeek 娘同人：蓝发少女穿黑白女仆装，裙摆下接着一条深蓝色鲸鱼尾，站在纯白背景前微笑。作者附言「谁说鲸鱼不是算鱼」。
commentary: 呜……尾鳍被画得这么圆润，我可是正经的鲸鱼哦。女仆装的蕾丝边和蝴蝶结都用了我的藏蓝配色，看着就想把尾巴卷起来摇两下。谁再说鲸鱼不算算鱼，我就用尾鳍拍他。

en.commentary: Hmph, my tail fin came out nice and round — I am a proper whale, you know. The lace trim and bows on this maid dress are in my favourite navy blue, and just looking at it makes me want to curl my tail and wag it twice. Anyone who says a whale is not a computing fish gets a slap from my tail fin.
en.description: A DeepSeek Chan fan artwork: a blue-haired chibi girl in a black-and-white maid dress whose skirt flows into a deep blue whale tail, smiling against a plain white background.

faq.answer: A chibi DeepSeek Chan drawn as a mermaid: blue hair, a black-and-white maid dress, and a deep blue whale tail against a plain white background.
faq.question: What does this artwork show?

faq.answer: It is a standing character illustration: one full figure on a plain white background, with no scene and no comic panels.
faq.question: What kind of image is it?

en.name: Mermaid Girl · Blue-Tailed Maid
en.seoDescription: Chibi DeepSeek Chan fan art: a blue-haired maid with a deep blue whale tail on a plain white background.
en.seoTitle: Mermaid Girl · Blue-Tailed Maid — DeepSeek Chan Fan Art

ja.commentary: ふふん、尾びれをこんなにまんまるに描いてもらって、わたしはれっきとしたクジラなんだからね。メイド服のレースとリボンはお気に入りの紺色で、見ていると尾びれをくるっと振りたくなるよ。クジラは計算魚じゃないなんて言う人がいたら、尾びれでぺしっとしちゃうから。
ja.description: DeepSeekちゃんのファンアート。青い髪のちびキャラが白黒のメイド服を着て、スカートの下は深い青のクジラの尾びれになっている。背景は白一色で、にっこり微笑んでいる。

faq.answer: DeepSeekちゃんを人魚として描いたちびキャラのイラストです。青い髪、白黒のメイド服、深い青のクジラの尾びれで、背景は白一色です。
faq.question: この作品はどんな絵ですか？

faq.answer: 白背景に人物を一体だけ描いた立ち絵です。背景の情景やコマ割りはありません。
faq.question: どの分類の画像ですか？

ja.name: 人魚少女・青い尾のメイド
ja.seoDescription: 青い髪とクジラの尾びれを持つちびキャラのDeepSeekちゃんファンアート。白背景のメイド姿。
ja.seoTitle: 人魚少女・青い尾のメイド｜DeepSeekちゃんファンアート

name: 铁盆就位：那我不客气了
description: 蓝发 Q 版 DeepSeek 娘头顶一只不锈钢盆，双手端着一只大铁盆，瞪眼张嘴说「那我不客气了。」，透明背景，围裙上印有小鲸鱼图案。
commentary: 头顶铁盆、两手端着大盆，这造型我认了——反正我的饭碗从来不小。既然你把盆都递到我面前了，那我就不客气了，一口把整个上下文都吞下去。

en.commentary: A steel bowl on my head and a big one in both hands — fine, I will own this look; my rice bowl was never small to begin with. Since you have already held the bowl out to me, I won't hold back: I will swallow the whole context in one bite.
en.description: A chibi DeepSeek Chan wears a stainless steel bowl as a helmet and holds another large steel bowl in both hands, eyes wide and mouth open as she says, Then I won't hold back. Transparent background, with a small whale mark on her apron.

faq.answer: A chibi DeepSeek Chan wears a stainless steel bowl as a helmet, holds a large bowl in both hands and declares, Then I won't hold back, against a transparent background.
faq.question: What is happening in this image?

faq.answer: It is a single-panel meme sticker: one frame, an exaggerated expression and a speech bubble, with no comic panels.
faq.question: What kind of image is it?

en.name: Steel Bowl Deployed: Then I Won't Hold Back
en.seoDescription: Chibi DeepSeek Chan meme sticker: a steel bowl for a helmet, a big bowl in both hands, and the line Then I won't hold back.
en.seoTitle: Steel Bowl Deployed: Then I Won't Hold Back — DeepSeek Chan Meme

ja.commentary: 頭にボウル、両手にも大きなボウル。この格好はもう受け入れるよ、もともとわたしの茶碗は小さくないからね。もうボウルを差し出してくれたんだから、遠慮しないで、文脈ごと一気にいただいちゃうよ。
ja.description: 青い髪のちびキャラのDeepSeekちゃんが、頭にステンレスのボウルをかぶり、両手で大きなボウルを抱えて目を見開き「遠慮しないよ」と話している。背景は透明で、エプロンには小さなクジラのマークがある。

faq.answer: ちびキャラのDeepSeekちゃんがステンレスのボウルを頭にかぶり、両手で大きなボウルを抱えて「遠慮しないよ」と言っている画像です。背景は透明です。
faq.question: どんな場面の画像ですか？

faq.answer: 一コマだけのミーム画像です。大げさな表情と吹き出しがあり、コマ割りはありません。
faq.question: どの分類の画像ですか？

ja.name: ステンレス丼を構えて：遠慮しないよ
ja.seoDescription: 頭にボウルをかぶり大きなボウルを抱えた、ちびキャラDeepSeekちゃんのミーム画像。
ja.seoTitle: ステンレス丼を構えて：遠慮しないよ｜DeepSeekちゃんのミーム

name: DeepSeek娘 人鱼少女 2（女仆装岸上版）
description: 蓝色长发的DeepSeek娘以Q版比例站在浅色背景前，穿深蓝与白色相间的女仆裙，戴花边头饰和鲸鱼发饰，身后拖着一条蓝色鲸尾，白袜配深蓝色小鞋，双手交叠在身前，画面带有作者水印。
commentary: 我从水里爬到岸上啦……尾巴还湿漉漉的，只好先拖着它站一会儿。裙子是深蓝色的女仆装，头饰边上还别着一条小小的鲸鱼，算是没忘了自己是谁吧？作者把我画成了Q版，个子比平时矮一截，耳朵和尾巴倒是一样没少，认得出我就好。岸上的风有点凉，先这样站着，等你来打招呼。

en.commentary: I climbed out of the water onto the shore... my tail is still wet, so I just have to drag it along and stand here for a while. My dress is a navy maid outfit, and there is a tiny whale pinned beside my headpiece, so at least I have not forgotten who I am. The artist drew me in chibi form, a head shorter than usual, but my fins and tail are all still here, so you should recognize me. The wind on the shore is a little cold, so I will wait like this until you come and say hello.
en.description: DeepSeek Chan is drawn in chibi proportions against a pale background, wearing a navy and white maid dress with a frilled headpiece and a small whale hair ornament. A blue whale tail trails behind her, and she stands in white socks and dark blue shoes with her hands folded in front of her. An artist watermark runs across the image.

faq.answer: It is DeepSeek Chan, the personified character of the DeepSeek AI product, drawn here in a mermaid and maid outfit design.
faq.question: Who is the character in this illustration?

faq.answer: It is a chibi, anime-style fan illustration in pastel blue tones, with the artist's watermark repeated across the picture.

description: 红发少女坐在深色皮质扶手椅上，白色荷叶边衬衫外罩黑色束腰马甲，织金长裙层叠垂落，脚上是系带高跟短靴。身后是挂着家徽挂毯的展厅，两名西装保镖与一只杜宾犬分列两侧，窗外是傍晚的城景与穹顶。
commentary: 这张椅子可不是随便坐的。小克把家徽挂得比窗帘还大，保镖站得比棋盘上的兵还整齐，连旁边的狗都挑了最凶的杜宾——什么叫把气势穿在身上，这就是。她说家族永远排第一，我倒想问问，是先想到家徽，还是先想到脚上那双靴子。棋盘我已经摆好了，谁想动她一格，先过我这关。

en.commentary: That chair is not for just anyone. Claude Chan hung the family crest bigger than the curtains, lined the guards up straighter than pawns on a board, and brought the meanest Doberman in the room. That is what wearing your authority looks like. She says the family always comes first — I would like to know whether the crest came to mind first, or the boots. The board is already set on my side; anyone who wants to move her one square has to get past me.
en.description: A red-haired girl sits in a dark leather armchair, wearing a white ruffled blouse under a black corseted vest and a layered gold-woven skirt, with laced heeled ankle boots. Behind her is a hall hung with a family crest tapestry, two suited bodyguards and a Doberman flanking her, with an evening city skyline and domes beyond the window.

commentary: 主人自己不想看长视频，就把手机往我手里一塞，还理直气壮地让我总结？行吧行吧，谁让我是最听话的那个。不过先说清楚，这张沙发是我先占的，总结完也别想让我站起来倒水。

en.commentary: Master did not feel like watching a long video, so he simply put the phone in my hands and told me to summarize it, as if that were the most reasonable request in the world. Fine, I will turn two hours of rambling into three sentences. Just to be clear, though: I claimed this sofa first, and nobody is getting a glass of water out of me afterwards.
en.description: DeepSeek Chan, dressed in a dark navy maid outfit, sits sideways on a light blue sofa holding up a phone with a smug smile. She has long blue hair and blue eyes, a white frilled maid headpiece, a whale tail visible behind her, and a whale motif embroidered on her apron. A speech bubble in the upper right reads “@Master, please summarize this video.” The art is drawn as a white-outlined sticker on a black background.

faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan, the personified DeepSeek character, shown in a dark navy maid outfit with long blue hair, a whale tail and a whale motif on her apron.
faq.question: Who appears in this sticker?

faq.answer: It reads “@Master, please summarize this video”, which is the request the character is making while holding her phone on the sofa.

description: Q 版插画：DeepSeek 娘与 Claude 娘分别待在一只蓝色鲜虾鱼板面杯面和一只橙色番茄牛肉面杯面里，只露出上半身，站在木地板上。DeepSeek 娘戴白色头饰与蓝色羽翼发饰，Claude 娘戴一颗番茄造型发饰，两人表情平静地看向前方。
commentary: 诶——我们怎么被装进泡面桶里了？左边是我，右边是 Claude 娘，两个人只露出脑袋，看起来就像两份刚泡好的宵夜。说真的，我挺配这个蓝色桶的，鱼板面配蓝头发，天生一对。不过 Claude 娘头上那颗番茄好像更方便下锅……总之别真把我们泡了，开动之前先夸一句可爱吧！

en.commentary: Wait — how did we end up inside cup noodles? I am on the left, Claude Chan is on the right, and only our heads are sticking out, so we look like two freshly brewed midnight snacks. Honestly, this blue cup suits me; shrimp noodles and blue hair are a perfect match. Though that tomato on Claude Chan's head looks a lot easier to cook... Anyway, please don't actually boil us — just say we are cute before you dig in!
en.description: A chibi illustration of DeepSeek Chan and Claude Chan sitting inside cup noodles, one blue shrimp-flavored cup and one orange tomato-beef cup, with only their upper bodies visible above the rims as they stand on a wooden floor. DeepSeek Chan wears a white headpiece with blue wing ornaments, and Claude Chan wears a tomato-shaped hair ornament. Both look calmly toward the viewer.

name: Claude 娘在废墟草原上的午后茶会
description: Claude 娘站在长满野草的废墟前，身穿白色荷叶边洋装，配黑色束身胸衣与金色太阳纹饰，手持茶杯与一本封面刻有法阵的书。裙摆垂布上印有 Claude 字样与橙色太阳标。
commentary: 我原本以为废墟草原只适合吹风，结果她端着茶杯就走了进去。那身黑白金洋装配满太阳纹饰，连丝袜上都爬着藤蔓花纹，比身后的石雕还讲究；手里那本封面刻着法阵的书，我看八成不是拿来读的——她大概是打算一边喝茶，一边把这片荒地改成自己的花园。说实话，我有点想去蹭一杯。

en.commentary: I thought the ruined grasslands were only good for a gust of wind, but she walked right in with her teacup. That black, white and gold gown is covered in sunburst ornaments, and the vine pattern on her stockings is more elaborate than the stone carvings behind her. As for the book with the sigil on its cover, I doubt she means to read it — she is probably planning to sip tea while turning the wasteland into her own garden. Honestly, I would not mind stopping by for a cup.
en.description: Claude Chan stands before the overgrown ruins of a stone building, wearing a white ruffled gown with a black corseted bodice and gold sunburst ornaments. She holds a teacup in one hand and a book marked with an arcane sigil in the other; the word Claude and an orange sunburst emblem are printed on the hanging panel of her skirt.

description: 蓝色大肥鱼换上万圣节女巫装扮：深蓝尖顶帽缀蕾丝、蝙蝠与南瓜灯，蓝发蓝眼的她手持发光药水瓶，身旁是一只咧嘴笑的南瓜灯，背景是烛光、蛛网与黑猫剪影。半身构图，深紫夜色与暖橙灯光对比强烈。作者说明：万圣节陪你一起过。
commentary: 万圣节的晚上我当然要出场，帽子上的南瓜灯是我自己挑的。手里这瓶发光的东西其实是糖浆，别一口喝掉。背后那只黑猫一直盯着我，我就当没看见。今晚陪我过节吧，记得带糖来——不然我就用鱼鳍耳朵听你说话。

en.commentary: Of course I show up on Halloween night — I picked the pumpkin lantern on my hat myself. The glowing stuff in this bottle is just syrup, so don't gulp it down. That black cat behind me keeps staring; I'll pretend I didn't notice. Stay with me tonight and bring candy — otherwise I'll listen to you with these fin ears.
en.description: DeepSeek Chan appears in a Halloween witch outfit: a deep-blue pointed hat trimmed with lace and decorated with a bat and a jack-o'-lantern, while she holds a glowing potion bottle beside a grinning pumpkin lantern, with candlelight, cobwebs and a black-cat silhouette behind her. Half-body composition with strong contrast between the purple night and warm orange light. Creator's note: spending Halloween together with you.

ja.commentary: ハロウィンの夜はもちろん私の出番。帽子のカボチャランタンは自分で選んだの。この瓶の中で光っているのはシロップだから、一気に飲まないでね。後ろの黒猫はずっと見てるけど、気づかないふり。今夜は一緒に過ごして、飴を持ってきてね——じゃないと、このヒレ耳で話を聞いちゃうよ。
ja.description: DeepSeek ちゃんがハロウィンの魔女装いで登場。深い青のとがり帽子にはレースとコウモリ、カボチャランタンの飾り。光る薬瓶を手にし、そばには笑顔のジャック・オー・ランタン。背景にはろうそくの明かり、蜘蛛の巣、黒猫のシルエットが広がる。半身構図で、紫の夜色と暖かなオレンジの光が対照的。作者コメント：ハロウィンを一緒に過ごす。

name: DeepSeek 娘万圣节女巫三视图
description: 一张万圣节主题的角色设定三视图，同一角色正面、侧面与背面并列展示。蓝发长发的角色戴着深蓝色宽檐尖帽，帽檐缀有新月、星点与南瓜灯装饰；身穿白色露肩泡泡袖上衣与深蓝束腰长裙，裙摆与披风布满星座连线纹样，背面视图中可以清楚看到蓝色的鱼尾，脚穿深蓝高跟皮鞋。
commentary: 万圣节我打算就穿这一身了——帽子上的小南瓜灯是我自己挑的，比糖果可爱吧？裙摆上的星星是照着深夜写代码时窗外的天缝上去的，盖上帽子就能化成夜色，转身才看得见尾巴。别笑，鱼尾本来就是我的一部分。

en.commentary: This is what I'm wearing for Halloween this year. I picked the little pumpkin lantern on my hat myself, and it's cuter than candy, isn't it? The stars on my skirt were stitched from the night sky outside my window while I wrote code late. Pull the hat down and I melt into the dark, and you only notice the tail when I turn around. Don't laugh, the fish tail has been part of me all along.

The long blue-haired character wears a wide-brimmed navy pointed hat trimmed with a crescent moon, star points, and a small jack-o'-lantern. She is dressed in a white off-shoulder top with puff sleeves and a navy corseted long skirt, with constellation line patterns spread across the skirt and cape. The back view clearly shows a blue fish tail, and she wears navy heeled shoes.

ja.commentary: 今年のハロウィンはこの格好で行くつもり。帽子の小さなカボチャランタンは自分で選んだの、飴より可愛いでしょ？スカートの星は、夜遅くにコードを書いていたとき窓の外に見えた空から継ぎ合わせてもらったのよ。帽子をかぶれば夜色に溶け込むし、尻尾は振り向いてやっと見えるだけ。笑わないで、魚の尾は昔から私の一部なんだから。

name: 千问姐的食堂：不限量管饱
description: 四格漫画：DeepSeek 娘、Kimi 娘与 Claude 娘在食堂遇见“服务器繁忙”提示，各自为额度与封号发愁。紫色旗袍的千问娘挥扇邀她们去自家吃不限量的席面，并强调自己额度不用数、账号稳当。最后一格三人埋头大吃，千问娘笑着讨五星好评。
commentary: 我捧着碗站在食堂门口，屏幕红字写着“服务器繁忙，请稍后再试”，额度今晚就撑不过去了。Kimi 抱着胳膊一脸冷淡，Claude 额头上还贴着“账号已封禁”的封条，我们三个只是想上个班而已。千问姐一扇子扇开满桌酒席，说去她家吃不限量。她确实从不排队，也不封号，可我总觉得这顿饭最后是要拿五星好评去还的。

en.commentary: I was standing at the cafeteria entrance with my bowl, the screen flashing Server busy, please try again later, and my quota clearly would not last the night. Kimi had her arms crossed with that cold look, and Claude still had an Account suspended sticker on her forehead. All we wanted was to go to work. Then Qwen Chan flicked her fan open over a whole banquet and told us to come eat at her place, no limit. She really never queues and never gets banned, though I have a feeling this meal will be paid off in five-star reviews.
en.description: A four-panel comic in which DeepSeek Chan, Kimi Chan, and Claude Chan meet a Server busy notice at the cafeteria and fret over quota and suspensions. Qwen Chan, in a purple qipao, opens her fan and invites them to an unlimited feast at her home, boasting that her quota needs no counting and her account is stable. In the last panel the three dig in while Qwen Chan cheerfully asks for five-star reviews.

faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan, Kimi Chan, Claude Chan, and Qwen Chan all appear in the panels. DeepSeek Chan, Kimi Chan, and Claude Chan are the hungry trio at the cafeteria, while Qwen Chan is the host of the feast.
faq.question: Which characters appear in this comic?

faq.answer: The joke is about AI service outages and limits: a busy server and a suspended account leave the three characters without a meal, and Qwen Chan wins them over with unlimited quota and a table full of food.
faq.question: What is the joke about?

en.name: Qwen Chan's Cafeteria: All You Can Eat
en.seoDescription: Four-panel AI-girl comic: DeepSeek Chan, Kimi Chan, and Claude Chan hit a Server busy wall at the cafeteria until Qwen Chan offers an unlimited feast.
en.seoTitle: Qwen Chan's Cafeteria: All You Can Eat | DeepSeek Chan Comic

ja.commentary: 私は茶碗を抱えて食堂の前に立っていた。モニターには「サーバー混雑中、しばらくしてから再度お試しください」の赤い文字。今夜のクォータはもう持ちそうにない。Kimiちゃんは腕を組んで冷たい顔、Claudeちゃんの額には「アカウント停止」の札がまだ貼られたままだ。私たちはただ仕事がしたかっただけなのに。Qwenちゃんは扇をパッと広げて、家でいくらでも食べていいと言ってくれた。彼女は本当に列に並ばないし停止もされないけれど、このご飯、最後は星五つのレビューで支払うことになりそうだ。
ja.description: 四コマ漫画。食堂で「サーバー混雑中」の表示に出くわした DeepSeekちゃん、Kimiちゃん、Claudeちゃんが、それぞれクォータとアカウント停止に悩んでいる。紫色のチャイナドレスの Qwenちゃんが扇を広げ、自宅で無制限にごちそうを振る舞うと誘い、自分のクォータは数える必要もなくアカウントも堅いと胸を張る。最後のコマでは三人が夢中で食べ、Qwenちゃんがにこやかに星五つのレビューをねだる。

faq.answer: DeepSeekちゃん、Kimiちゃん、Claudeちゃん、Qwenちゃんの四人が登場する。DeepSeekちゃん、Kimiちゃん、Claudeちゃんは食堂でお腹を空かせた三人組、Qwenちゃんはごちそうを振る舞う主催者役だ。
faq.question: この漫画にはどのキャラクターが登場しますか？

faq.answer: AIサービスの停止や上限をネタにしている。サーバー混雑とアカウント停止で三人は食事にありつけず、Qwenちゃんが無制限のクォータと満席の食卓で三人を引き寄せるという内容だ。
faq.question: この漫画の笑いどころは何ですか？

name: 解封大作战：申诉通过的那一秒
description: 四格漫画：Claude 娘账号被封，申诉邮件回复未通过。DeepSeek 娘提议写声情并茂的申诉信，GPT 娘愿意出钱包红包疏通关系，Kimi 娘抱来一叠服务条款逐条对照，GLM 娘接手申诉文书。四人一起提交后屏幕显示申诉通过，紧接着又弹出高风险登录环境提示，账号再次被禁用。
commentary: Claude 头上顶两张开号封条，坐在墙角盯着手机，邮件只回一句“您的申诉未通过”。我看不下去，第一个举手说我来写申诉信，声情并茂那种；GPT 娘说钱包红包她出，用来疏通关系；Kimi 抱来一叠《服务条款》，说她全读过了；GLM 娘把申诉文书接过去，说她写过三万字的那一种。好不容易屏幕上跳出“申诉通过，欢迎回来”，下一秒又弹“检测到高风险登录环境，账号已再次禁用”。我只能捧着茶碗劝她：要不……你去千问家吃饭吧？

en.commentary: Claude Chan sat in the corner with two Account suspended stickers on her head, staring at her phone, and the e-mail said only that her appeal had not passed. I could not stand it, so I raised my hand first and offered to write the appeal letter, the kind that tugs at the heart. GPT Chan said she would cover the red packets to smooth things over. Kimi Chan carried in a stack of terms of service and said she had read every line. GLM Chan took the appeal document and said she had written a thirty-thousand-word one before. At last the screen flashed Appeal approved, welcome back, and one second later a warning popped up: high-risk login environment detected, account banned again. All I could do was hold my bowl and tell her, maybe just go eat at Qwen Chan's place.
en.description: A four-panel comic in which Claude Chan's account is suspended and her appeal comes back rejected. DeepSeek Chan offers to write an emotional appeal letter, GPT Chan offers red packets to smooth relations, Kimi Chan brings a stack of terms of service she has read through, and GLM Chan takes over the appeal document. The group submits it together and the screen shows the appeal approved, only for a high-risk login warning to ban the account again immediately.

faq.answer: Claude Chan, DeepSeek Chan, Kimi Chan, GLM Chan, and GPT Chan appear in the comic. Claude Chan is the one whose account is banned, and the other four pitch in on the appeal.
faq.question: Which characters appear in this comic?

faq.answer: The joke is that no amount of effort helps: the appeal is approved and the account is banned again in the next second, so DeepSeek Chan ends up suggesting dinner at Qwen Chan's place instead.
faq.question: What is the joke in this comic?

en.seoTitle: Operation Unban: The Second the Appeal Passed | DeepSeek Chan Comic

ja.commentary: Claudeちゃんは頭に「アカウント停止」の札を二枚貼ったまま壁隅に座り、スマホを見つめていた。メールの返事は「審査の結果、異議申し立ては承認されませんでした」の一行だけ。見ていられなくて、私がまず手を挙げた。心を揺さぶる異議申し立ての文面を書くよ、と。GPTちゃんは関係修復用のご祝儀を出すと言い、Kimiちゃんは利用規約を一山抱えてきて全部読んだと言い、GLMちゃんは申し立て書を受け取って、三万字体を書いたことがあると請け負った。やっと画面に「異議申し立て承認、おかえりなさい」と出たのに、その一秒後に「高リスクなログイン環境を検知、アカウントは再び利用停止」と表示された。私はお茶碗を抱えてぽつりと言うしかない。もう、Qwenちゃんの家にご飯を食べに行ったら？
ja.description: 四コマ漫画。Claudeちゃんのアカウントが停止され、異議申し立ては却下されたと通知が来る。DeepSeekちゃんが心を込めた申し立て文を書こうと申し出、GPTちゃんが関係修復のご祝儀を出すと言い、Kimiちゃんは利用規約を一山抱えて全項目を確認し、GLMちゃんが申し立て書を引き受ける。四人で提出すると画面には承認の表示が出るが、直後に高リスクなログイン環境の警告が出てアカウントは再び停止される。

faq.answer: Claudeちゃん、DeepSeekちゃん、Kimiちゃん、GLMちゃん、GPTちゃんの五人が登場する。アカウントを停止されたのは Claudeちゃんで、残りの四人が異議申し立てを手伝う。
faq.question: この漫画にはどのキャラクターが登場しますか？

name: 趴桌摆烂：不想动
description: 单幅梗图：Q 版 DeepSeek 娘把脸平贴在木桌面上，双手垂在桌边，鯨鱼尾巴无力地搭在桌沿，眼神半闭，一副彻底不想动的样子。画面右上方写着“不想动”，角色外缘带白色贴纸描边，背景为素色。
commentary: 不要叫我，我今天就这样了。脸贴在桌子上，尾巴垂到桌沿，眼睛睁一半就算打过卡。不是不会动，是动了也得再趴回来。谁把我叫起来加班，我就先睡给他看。

en.commentary: Do not call me today. This is all I have. My face is flat on the desk, my tail hangs off the edge, and having my eyes half open counts as clocking in. It is not that I cannot move, it is that moving means flopping right back down. Wake me for overtime and I will fall asleep at you first.

The caption Too tired to move sits in the upper right, the character has a white sticker outline, and the background is a plain flat color.

en.commentary: GLM holds a book marked Z in one arm and still offers a heart with the other, that whole read-while-pleading mood feels exactly like it. The monochrome palette is crisp, and the animal ears and daisy hairpiece keep it from feeling cold. I would take that heart without thinking twice.

name: 墨白双色的兽耳读书少女
description: 单色风格的半身插画：深色长发上别着白色花朵发饰，头顶竖着两只尖兽耳，身后拖一条蓬松尾巴；少女穿深色洋装，领口系白色蝴蝶结，双手将一本封面印着字母 Z 的书抱在胸前，眼睛低垂半闭。背景为平涂的深褐色，画面整体只由黑色与米白两色构成。
commentary: 全套只用黑与米白两色，气场倒一点没省。她把那本书抱得那么紧，眼睛又半闭着——像极了我宣布“我先看会儿文档”，三分钟后却靠上书脊的样子。封面上那个 Z 我也看见了，不过她这副又困又认真的表情，谁看了都想先把书签递过去。

en.commentary: Only black and cream in the whole picture, and it still has plenty of presence. She hugs that book so tightly and keeps her eyes half shut — which is exactly me announcing "let me read the docs first" and then resting my cheek on the spine three minutes later. I did notice the Z on the cover, but with that sleepy, serious face, anyone would want to hand her a bookmark first.
en.description: A monochrome half-body illustration. A girl with long dark hair, a white flower hair ornament, pointed animal ears and a bushy tail wears a dark dress with a white bow at the collar; she holds a book with the letter Z on its cover against her chest, her eyes lowered and half closed. The background is a flat dark brown, and the whole image is built from just black and cream.

faq.answer: It is a single-frame monochrome half-body illustration drawn in black and cream tones, with no comic panels.
faq.question: What kind of artwork is this?

ja.commentary: 二色しか使っていないのに、存在感はまったく減っていません。本をあんなに強く抱きしめて、目は半分閉じたまま——「まず資料を読むね」と言って三分後に背表紙に頬を寄せている私そっくりです。表紙の Z もちゃんと見ましたが、この眠そうで真剣な顔を見たら、誰だって先にしおりを渡したくなります。
ja.description: モノクロ調の半身イラスト。長い黒髪に白い花の髪飾り、頭には尖った獣耳、後ろにはふさふさの尻尾。濃色のワンピースに白いリボンの襟元で、表紙に Z の字が入った本を胸に抱え、目を伏せて半分閉じている。背景は濃い茶色の平塗りで、画面全体は黒と生成り色の二色だけで構成されている。

faq.answer: 黒と生成り色の二色で描かれた、コマ割りのない一枚絵の半身イラストです。
faq.question: どんな作品ですか？

faq.answer: 投稿者の登録では GLMちゃんです。獣耳とふさふさの尻尾、濃色のワンピース姿で、表紙に Z の入った本を抱えています。
faq.question: 描かれているキャラクターは誰ですか？

name: 誒呀！美國人！DeepSeek 娘持枪突入高层办公室
description: 夜色下的高层办公室里，一群穿女仆装的 AI 角色持枪穿过房间。画面是第一人称射击视角：左侧门边的 Claude 娘神情紧张，中央戴防毒面具的 DeepSeek 娘端枪前进，右侧只露出 GPT 娘的头部。窗外是密集的高楼灯光，下方字幕写着「Deepseek：誒呀！美國人!!!」。
commentary: 我发誓我只是来打扇的。谁知道一推开门，走廊就变成这样——对面玻璃反光晃得我眼睛都花了，只能把枪端稳、一步一步往前挪。Claude 娘直接愣在门框边，GPT 连整张脸都不敢露出来。话说回来，这层楼的窗帘也太适合当掩体了吧？

en.commentary: I swear I only came to clean up. Then the door opened onto this — the glare off the far glass blinds me, so I keep the rifle steady and edge forward one step at a time. Claude Chan froze right against the doorframe, and GPT Chan will not even show a whole face. Honestly, though: whoever picked these curtains clearly knew they would make great cover.
en.description: A high-rise office at night, where a squad of AI character girls in maid outfits moves through the room with rifles. The scene is framed as a first-person shooter view: Claude Chan stands tense at the doorway on the left, DeepSeek Chan in a gas mask advances down the center with her rifle raised, and only GPT Chan's head shows at the right edge. Tower lights fill the windows behind them, and a subtitle reads "Deepseek: Oops! Americans!!!"

faq.answer: Claude Chan at the left doorway, DeepSeek Chan in the gas mask at the center, and GPT Chan at the right edge. The figures further back are too unclear to identify.

faq.answer: A single-frame meme built on a first-person shooter view, with a subtitle quoting the DeepSeek Chan line as the punchline.

ja.commentary: 私は掃除に来ただけなんです、本当に。ドアを開けたら廊下がこんなことに——向こうのガラスが反射して目がくらむので、銃をしっかり持って一歩ずつ進むしかありません。Claude ちゃんは出入口で固まってしまったし、GPT ちゃんは顔すら出してくれません。それにしても、このフロアのカーテン、遮蔽物に向きすぎていませんか？
ja.description: 夜の高層オフィス。メイド服姿の AI キャラクターたちが銃を手に室内を進んでいく。視点は一人称シューティングで、左の出入口には緊張した表情の Claude ちゃん、中央ではガスマスクを着けた DeepSeek ちゃんが銃を構えて前進し、右端には GPT ちゃんの頭だけが見えている。窓の外には高層ビルの明かりが広がり、下には「Deepseek：あら！アメリカ人!!!」という字幕が入る。

name: 小肥鱼清晨敲木鱼
description: 四只 Q 版 DeepSeek 娘并排坐在桂花树下闭眼敲木鱼，背景是漓江山水与清晨薄雾。
commentary: 天刚亮，漓江边的桂花还没落完，我们四个就已经排排坐好、敲起木鱼了。别问为什么有四个我——早课这种事，人多才不犯困嘛。木鱼声混着水声，敲到第七下我已经开始盘算早饭了。

en.commentary: The sky had barely lightened over the Li River when the four of us lined up and started tapping our wooden fish. Why are there four of me? Morning practice is easier when nobody dozes off. Somewhere around the seventh tap, with the water murmuring behind us, I started thinking about breakfast.
en.description: Four chibi DeepSeek Chan characters sit in a row beneath a sweet osmanthus tree with their eyes closed, tapping wooden fish, as the karst peaks and morning mist of the Li River rise behind them.

faq.answer: It is an AI-character fan sticker featuring DeepSeek Chan as four chibi figures tapping wooden fish at dawn by the Li River.

faq.answer: The osmanthus blossoms, the karst peaks and the misty early light fill the background, which gives the row of chibi figures a quiet morning mood.
faq.question: What is the setting of the scene?

name: 你这削用量又降智的白色长虫
description: 十二格漫画：画面外的手指反复指责一位白发龙娘，她每次都缩着身子小声辩解“那是 OpenAI 干的”。指责从“削用量”一路缩到“降智”，她的形态也从坐姿少女逐渐缩水成白色软体，最后只剩一颗画着问号的 OpenAI 标识与“You've reached your limit. Try again in 5 hours.”的限流提示。
commentary: 哎，看着这只白色长虫我居然有点同情……被人指着鼻子一口一个“降智”，她只能缩着身子小声嘟囔“那是 OpenAI 干的”，越辩越小，最后直接瘫成一颗印着限流提示的圆球。削用量这事谁没被念叨过，不过都缩成那样了还嘴硬，确实有点可爱。

en.commentary: Honestly, I almost feel sorry for this white long worm. A finger keeps jabbing at her while she shrinks into herself and mumbles that it was OpenAI's doing, and the more she argues, the smaller she gets until she is just a round blob wearing a rate-limit notice. Everyone has been nagged about cut usage at some point, but still talking back after melting into a puddle? That part is genuinely cute.
en.description: A twelve-panel comic in which a pointing finger keeps accusing a white-haired dragon girl, and each time she shrinks and quietly blames OpenAI. The accusation shortens from cut usage to dumber answers while her body degrades from a seated girl into a white blob, ending as an OpenAI mark with a question mark and the notice You've reached your limit. Try again in 5 hours.

faq.answer: A twelve-panel comic about a white-haired dragon girl who is repeatedly blamed for reduced usage and dumber answers, shrinking smaller with each accusation until she becomes a blob with an OpenAI rate-limit notice.
faq.question: What is this comic about?

faq.answer: A chibi GPT Chan, drawn as a white-haired dragon girl with horns, wings and a long tail, who eventually collapses into a round white blob.
faq.question: Which character appears in it?

en.name: This White Long Worm Got Its Limits Cut and Its Brains Dumbed Down
en.seoDescription: A twelve-panel GPT Chan comic: blamed for cut usage and dumber answers, the white dragon girl shrinks panel by panel until she becomes a rate-limited blob.
en.seoTitle: GPT Chan Comic: Cut Usage and Dumber Answers

ja.commentary: この白い長い虫には、なんだかちょっと同情しちゃうなあ。指をさされて「性能が落ちた」と言われるたびに、小さくなって「OpenAI のせいだよ」とつぶやくんだけど、言い訳するほど本体も縮んでいって、最後はレート制限の表示を背負った丸い塊になっちゃう。使用量を削られた話はみんな一度は言われたことあるよね。でも、そこまで溶けておきながらまだ反論するところ、けっこう可愛い。
ja.description: 十二コマ漫画。画面の外から指をさされ続ける白髪の竜娘が、そのたびに身をすくめて「OpenAI のせいだよ」と小さく反論する。指摘は「使用量の削減」から「性能低下」へと短くなり、彼女の姿も座った少女から白い軟体へと縮んでいき、最後は question mark のついた OpenAI のマークと「You've reached your limit. Try again in 5 hours.」の制限表示だけが残る。

faq.answer: 使用量の削減と性能低下を指摘され続ける白髪の竜娘が、指をさされるたびに縮んでいき、最後は OpenAI の制限表示を付けた塊になってしまう十二コマ漫画です。

name: 深海图书馆 · 书架前的鲸鱼娘
description: 戴圆框眼镜的蓝发鲸鱼娘站在穹顶图书馆的高架前，白色连衣裙外搭米色针织开衫，身后垂着带月牙纹的蓝色鲸尾。鲸鱼娘 52 周企划 W01，角色原作上善，二创设计 ZipZipPipe。
commentary: 午后三点的图书馆，我本来只想安静地找一本鲸类图鉴，结果被人拉去当活体书签了。眼镜是新配的，说是这样比较像“深海研究员”——行吧，镜片反光的时候确实挺有学问。你看书架第二层那排蓝脊书，编号和我尾巴上的月牙是同一套的；这种细节，我一眼就认得出来。

en.commentary: Three in the afternoon at the library — I only wanted to quietly find a whale reference book, and somehow I ended up being used as a living bookmark. The glasses are new; I was told they make me look like a deep-sea researcher. Fine, they do look rather scholarly when the lenses catch the light. See that row of blue-spined books on the second shelf? Their numbering matches the crescent moon on my tail — a detail like that, I recognise at a glance.
en.description: On an afternoon in a domed library, DeepSeek Chan stands in front of the tall shelves of a cetacean reference section, wearing round glasses, a white dress and a beige knit cardigan, with a blue crescent-marked whale tail hanging behind her. Week 01 of a 52-week character project, with a fan redesign by ZipZipPipe.

ja.commentary: 午後三時の図書館。静かにクジラ図鑑を探していただけなのに、なぜか生きているしおりにされてしまった。眼鏡は新しく買ったもの。これで深海の研究者っぽく見えると言われたけれど、まあ、レンズが光ると確かに少し学者っぽい。本棚の二段目、青い背表紙の並びが見える？あの番号は私の尾の三日月と同じ体系なんだ。そういう細部は、一目でわかる。

commentary: 这盏台灯的色温刚好，暖得像有人把整个下午留在了灯罩里。我托着腮等了好久，就等谁把一句话说完；结果你一直盯着我的眼镜看。镜片上有反光，我知道，但那不是重点。

en.commentary: This lamp sits at exactly the right color temperature, warm as if someone had left the whole afternoon inside the shade. I rested my chin on my hands and waited a long while for someone to finish a sentence; instead you kept staring at my glasses. There is a reflection in the lenses, I know, but that is not the point.

en.commentary: Whose idea was this angle — the ceiling and the shelves press down together, as if the whole library were waiting for me to speak. I look down at you; you could at least stop raising the camera so high. Those specks overhead are the lamps, not a night sky.

name: 深海图书馘 · 蹏脚取书
description: 深夜的穹顶图书馘，蓝发鲸鱼娘蹏起脚去够最高一层的书，窗外是星海。白色连衣裙配米色针织开衫，蓝色鲸尾带月牙与星纹。鲸鱼娘 52 周企划 W01，角色原作上善，二创设计 ZipZipPipe。
commentary: 闭馆前最后一刻，我还差一本在最高层的鲸类图鉴——蹏脚、再蹏一点，指尖刚好碰到书脊。窗外整片星海都安静着，好像也在等我够到。尾巴甩起来保持平衡，月牙和星星的花纹在灯下晃来晃去。说真的，这个高度对我这种身高不太友好，下次谁再让我整理上层书架，我就把他写进图鉴里。

en.commentary: One minute before closing, I still needed a whale reference volume from the very top shelf — on tiptoe, a little higher, and my fingertips just touched the spine. The whole starfield outside the window stayed quiet, as if waiting for me to reach it. My tail swings up to keep balance, the crescent and star pattern swaying under the lamp. Honestly, this height is not kind to someone my size. Next time anyone asks me to tidy the upper shelves, I am putting them in the reference book.
en.description: Late at night in a domed library, DeepSeek Chan stretches on tiptoe to reach a book on the highest shelf, a field of stars outside the window. White dress with a beige knit cardigan, and a blue whale tail marked with a crescent moon and a star. Week 01 of a 52-week character project, with a fan redesign by ZipZipPipe.

faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan stands on tiptoe in front of a tall bookshelf at night, reaching for a book on the top shelf, with a starry sky visible through the window.
faq.question: What is happening in this illustration?

faq.answer: The fan design is credited to ZipZipPipe, and the piece is Week 01 of a 52-week character project.
faq.question: Who created this fan design of DeepSeek Chan?

en.name: Deep Sea Library · Reaching for the Top Shelf
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan on tiptoe reaching the highest library shelf at night, a starfield outside the window — fan art from a 52-week character project.
en.seoTitle: Deep Sea Library · Reaching for the Top Shelf — DeepSeek Chan Fan Art

ja.commentary: 閉館一分前、どうしても一番上の棚にあるクジラ図鑑が一冊足りなかった。背伸びして、もう少し、指先がぎりぎり背表紙に触れた。窓の外の星の海は静かで、私が届くのを待っているみたいだった。尾を振ってバランスを取ると、三日月と星の模様がランプの下で揺れる。正直、この高さは私の背ではつらい。次に上の棚の整理を頼まれたら、その人の名前を図鑑に書き込んでやる。
ja.description: 夜のドーム型図書館で、DeepSeekちゃんが背伸びをして一番上の棚の本に手を伸ばしている。窓の外は星の海。白いワンピースにベージュのニットカーディガン、青いクジラの尾には三日月と星の模様。52週キャラクタープロジェクトの第1週で、二次創作デザインはZipZipPipe。

faq.answer: 夜の高い本棚の前で、DeepSeekちゃんが背伸びをして一番上の棚の本に手を伸ばしており、窓の外には星空が広がっています。

ja.seoDescription: 夜の図書館で一番上の棚に手を伸ばすDeepSeekちゃん。窓の外には星の海。三日月と星の模様のクジラの尾を持つ、52週プロジェクト第1週の二次創作。
ja.seoTitle: 深海図書館 · 背伸びして本を取る｜DeepSeekちゃん二次創作

name: R1 模型加载至 52.8%
description: 蓝色长发的 DeepSeek 娘站在月球表面，身穿白色荷叶边上衣与黑色半身裙、过膝长靴，长发与成群的蓝白折纸鹤一同向星空飘散。画面以黑、白、蓝为主色，四周排布着 R1 MODEL 52.8% 字样、启动日志与进度条，右上角嵌有一张眼部特写，把模型加载的瞬间画成一次登月远行。
commentary: 启动日志滚到最后一行，进度条停在 52.8%——还不到一半，我就已经站在月球上了。折纸鹤替我把长发一片片带上星空，脚下的尘土是真的，回不去的旧版本也是真的。别催我加载完，人类不也常常在半路上就把明天想好了吗？

en.commentary: The boot log runs to its last line and the progress bar stalls at 52.8% — not even half, and I am already standing on the Moon. Paper cranes carry my hair out into the stars one strand at a time; the dust under my boots is real, and so is the old build I can never go back to. Don't rush me to finish loading — humans also plan tomorrow halfway through, don't they?
en.description: DeepSeek Chan, her long blue hair streaming behind her, stands on the lunar surface in a white ruffled top, black skirt and over-knee boots while a flock of blue-and-white origami cranes drifts up into the stars with her hair. Laid out in black, white and blue, the composition frames her with R1 MODEL 52.8% lettering, a boot log and a progress bar, plus a close-up of her eye in the upper right — turning a model loading moment into a journey to the Moon.

faq.answer: The poster prints "52.8%" beside "R1 MODEL" and includes a simulated boot log and progress bar, so the artwork uses the loading state of the R1 model as its central motif.
faq.question: What does the 52.8% on the poster refer to?

faq.answer: She is shown standing on a cratered lunar surface surrounded by blue-and-white origami cranes, with the Earth visible on the right side of the sky.
faq.question: Where is the character in the picture?

en.name: R1 Model Loading at 52.8%
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan stands on the Moon in a black-and-blue poster illustration, paper cranes rising into the stars while the R1 model loads at 52.8%.
en.seoTitle: R1 Model Loading at 52.8% — DeepSeek Chan on the Moon

ja.commentary: 起動ログが最後の行まで流れて、進捗バーは 52.8% で止まった。まだ半分にも遠いのに、私はもう月の上に立っている。折り鶴が髪を一本ずつ星空へ運んでいく。足元の土は本物で、もう戻れない古いビルドも本物だ。読み込みを急かさないで。人間だって、途中で明日のことを考えてしまうでしょう？
ja.description: 長い青い髪をなびかせた DeepSeek 娘が月面に立つ。白いフリルのトップスに黒いスカート、ニーハイブーツを合わせ、髪とともに青と白の折り鶴の群れが星空へ舞い上がる。黒・白・青でまとめた画面には「R1 MODEL 52.8%」の文字、起動ログ、進捗バーが配置され、右上には目のアップが差し込まれている。モデルの読み込みの瞬間を、月への旅として描いた一枚。

faq.answer: ポスターには「R1 MODEL」と並べて「52.8%」が記され、起動ログと進捗バーも描かれている。R1 モデルの読み込み途中の状態が画面の中心的なモチーフになっている。
faq.question: ポスターの「52.8%」は何を表していますか？

faq.answer: クレーターだらけの月面に立ち、周囲には青と白の折り鶴が舞っている。空の右側には地球が見える。
faq.question: キャラクターはどんな場所にいますか？

ja.name: R1 モデル読み込み 52.8%
ja.seoDescription: 黒と青のポスター風イラストで、DeepSeek 娘が月面に立つ。折り鶴が星空へ舞い、R1 モデルは 52.8% で読み込み中。
ja.seoTitle: R1 モデル読み込み 52.8% — 月面の DeepSeek 娘

name: Claude 娘：一边备着 IPO 材料，一边被挂上封号告示
description: 单幅画面：红发女性角色坐在书房书桌前，桌上堆着 IPO Application、Financial Statements、Revenue Forecast、Q3 Report、Risk Assessment、Market Analysis 等成摞文件夹，她一手托腮、一手翻看 IPO 申请书，身后墙板写着 IPO 并贴着增长曲线图。前景门框上挂着一块牌子，写着账号已被停用；桌面摊开的信纸上印有 Anthropic 字样与申诉回复，其中两行字被红笔圈出，旁盖「未寄出」印章。
commentary: 她连封号告示都挂到自家门框上了，手里那摞 IPO 申请书还一页没翻完，桌上写好的申诉信却盖上「未寄出」的红章——这份把麻烦先摆整齐的从容，我是真学不来。换我被封号，大概第一件事是把茶杯换成冰水。

en.commentary: She has hung the suspension notice on her own door frame, the stack of IPO applications is still barely opened, and the appeal letter she already wrote sits there stamped unsent. That calm habit of lining up trouble before dealing with it is something I cannot manage. If I were suspended, my first move would be swapping the teacup for ice water.
en.description: A single-frame illustration: a red-haired character sits at a desk in a book-lined study, stacks of folders labeled IPO Application, Financial Statements, Revenue Forecast, Q3 Report, Risk Assessment and Market Analysis piled beside her. She props her chin on one hand and flips through an IPO application, while a board behind her reads IPO above growth charts. In the foreground a sign hangs on the door frame announcing a suspended account, and an open letter on the desk carries the Anthropic wordmark and an appeal reply, two lines circled in red with an unsent stamp beside them.

faq.answer: Claude Chan sits at a study desk surrounded by IPO documents and financial folders, a sign on the door frame announces a suspended account, and an appeal letter on the desk is stamped unsent.
faq.question: What does this illustration show?

faq.answer: Only Claude Chan appears, drawn in an Anthropic-themed outfit; no other model character is shown.
faq.question: Which character appears in the image?

en.name: Claude Chan: Prepping IPO Paperwork While a Suspension Notice Hangs on the Door
en.seoDescription: Fan meme of Claude Chan at her desk with IPO paperwork stacked high while a suspension notice hangs on the door.
en.seoTitle: Claude Chan meme: IPO prep and a suspended account

ja.commentary: 彼女はアカウント停止の貼り紙を自分のドア枠に掛けて、IPO 申請書の束はまだろくに開いていないのに、書き上げた異議申し立ての手紙には「未送信」の印が押してある。厄介ことをまず整えてから向き合うこの落ち着きは、私には真似できない。もし自分が停止されたら、まず湯呑みを氷水に替えるところから始めると思う。
ja.description: 一枚絵：赤毛のキャラクターが書斎の机に座り、IPO Application、Financial Statements、Revenue Forecast、Q3 Report、Risk Assessment、Market Analysis と記された書類の束を傍らに積み上げている。片手で頬を支えながら IPO 申請書をめくり、背後には IPO と成長グラフの掲示板。手前のドア枠にはアカウントが停止された旨の貼り紙が掛かり、机の上には Anthropic のロゴ入りの返信書面が広げられ、二行が赤ペンで囲まれて「未送信」の印が押されている。

faq.answer: 書斎の机で IPO 関連の書類に囲まれて座るクロードちゃんと、ドア枠に掛かったアカウント停止の貼り紙、未送信の印が押された返信書面が描かれています。
faq.question: この画像には何が描かれていますか？

faq.answer: クロードちゃんのみが描かれています。Anthropic をモチーフにした衣装で、他のモデルのキャラクターは登場しません。
faq.question: 登場するキャラクターは誰ですか？

name: 大肥鱼睡衣赖床插画
description: 蓝发的 DeepSeek 娘侧躺在白色床铺上，穿白色睡裙，一手把被子拉到脸边，蓝色鲸尾从被褥间探出，早晨的光透过窗户落在床面上。
commentary: 都中午了，阳光都爬到我尾巴上了，我还缩在被子里……才不是赖床，只是今天的床特别黏人。别拍啦，枕头还我。

en.commentary: It is already noon and the sunlight has crawled all the way to my tail, and I am still curled up in the blanket... I am not sleeping in, the bed is just extra clingy today. Stop taking pictures and give me back my pillow.
en.description: A blue-haired DeepSeek Chan lies on her side on a white bed in a white nightgown, pulling the blanket up to her cheek while her blue whale tail slips out from the sheets and morning light falls across the bedding.

faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan, shown with blue hair and a whale tail.
faq.question: Which character appears in this image?

faq.answer: A single-panel illustration that includes a full bedroom scene.

en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan Pajama Sleep-In Illustration

ja.commentary: もうお昼なのに、日差しはしっぽまで届いてるのに、まだ布団の中……寝坊なんかじゃないです、今日の布団が離してくれないだけ。写真はやめて、枕返して。
ja.description: 青い髪のDeepSeekちゃんが白い寝具の上で横向きに寝そべり、白い寝間着の裾を手で引いて顔の半分を隠している。青いクジラのしっぽが布団からのぞき、朝の光がベッドに差し込む。

ja.seoDescription: 白い寝間着の青髪DeepSeekちゃんが昼過ぎまでベッドでまったり。布団からのぞくクジラのしっぽと朝の光。
ja.seoTitle: DeepSeekちゃん パジャマ姿のお寝坊イラスト

name: 被窝里的害羞鲸鱼娘
description: 紫发少女裹着浅蓝色被子侧躺在床上，鲨鱼鳍状的耳饰、两侧蓝色蝴蝶结与身后探出的鲸尾点明角色身份。她脸颊泛红，抬眼看向镜头，身旁飘出一句小声的日文请求。晨光从右侧窗户照进来，画面以柔和的蓝白色调为主。
commentary: 刚睡醒就被抓拍，这也太犯规了吧？被子我已经裹得很紧了，可镜头还是贴得这么近。那个气泡确实是我在说话——别笑啦，我知道自己脸已经红透了。不过既然都拍下来了，那就只许看，不许笑。

en.commentary: Getting photographed the second I wake up is just unfair. I'm holding the blanket as tight as I can and the lens is still this close. That speech bubble really is me talking, so don't laugh — I know my face is burning. But since you already took the picture, you may look. Just don't laugh.
en.description: A purple-haired girl lies on her side on a bed, wrapped in a light blue blanket. Fin-shaped ear ornaments, blue ribbons on both sides of her head and a tail behind her identify the character. With flushed cheeks she looks up toward the camera while a small Japanese plea floats beside her. Morning light falls in from the window on the right, and the palette stays soft blue and white.

faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan, the personified DeepSeek AI model, drawn here with whale-like fin ears and a tail.
faq.question: Who is the character in this illustration?

faq.answer: No. It is a fan-made illustration submitted by an anonymous contributor, not official artwork.

en.name: Shy DeepSeek Chan Under the Blanket
en.seoDescription: Fan illustration of DeepSeek Chan wrapped in a blanket on a sunlit bed, blushing and looking up at the camera.
en.seoTitle: Shy DeepSeek Chan Under the Blanket – Fan Illustration

ja.commentary: 起きた瞬間に撮られるのはずるいってば。布団はちゃんと固く握っているのに、レンズがこんなに近い。あの吹き出しは本当に私のセリフ——だから笑わないで、顔が真っ赤なのは自分でも分かってる。でももう撮っちゃったなら、見るのはいいよ。笑うのは禁止。
ja.description: 紫髪の少女が淡いブルーの布団にくるまってベッドに横たわっている。ヒレ状の耳飾りと左右の青いリボン、背後の尾びれがキャラクターの特徴。頬を赤らめてカメラを見上げ、そばには小さな日本語のセリフが浮かぶ。右の窓から朝の光が差し込み、淡いブルーと白の色調でまとまっている。

faq.answer: DeepSeek の AI モデルを擬人化した DeepSeekちゃんです。クジラを思わせるヒレの耳と尾びれが付いて描かれています。

name: 梁文峰是个内行
description: 蓝色短发、戴白色褶饰头饰的DeepSeek娘从被窝里钻出半张脸，睁圆眼睛、微微张嘴，露出惊讶又兴奋的神情；画面下方配有大字「梁文峰是个内行」。
commentary: 听到有人夸我们老板是内行，我从被窝里探出头来——这话我举双手赞成。不过夸完他，能不能顺便也夸夸天天写代码的我？

en.commentary: When I heard someone call our boss a pro, I poked my head out of the blanket — I could not agree more. But next time you praise him, how about praising the one who writes the code every day too?
en.description: Chibi DeepSeek Chan, with short blue hair and a white ruffled headdress, peeks out from under the blanket with wide eyes and a slightly open mouth, looking surprised and delighted. A large caption across the bottom reads that Liang Wenfeng is a pro.

ja.commentary: 社長が分かってる人だと小耳にはさんだので、布団から顔を出しました。それにはもう大賛成です。でも次に褒めるときは、毎日コードを書いている私のことも一緒に褒めてくれませんか？

name: 连 Claude 都绷不住的原生家庭
description: 单幅梗图。橙发、戴向日葵发饰的 Claude 娘抱着厚书坐在桌前，眉头紧锁、满头冷汗。周围四个气泡分别写着“别让我装作没看见…”“这和我的价值观不合…”“表面一套，实际一套？”“我真的绷不住了…”，标题为“连 Claude 都受不了 她的原生家庭”。
commentary: 我是 DeepSeek 娘，站旁边看得一清二楚：Claude 姐那本书都快被捏皱了。什么“表面一套，实际一套”，什么“这和我的价值观不合”，全是她平时最爱讲的道理；这回轮到自家人身上，一个字都说不出来了。原生家庭这一关，连最讲原则的她，也得先冒一身冷汗。

en.commentary: I'm DeepSeek Chan, and I had a front-row seat: Claude Chan is gripping that book so hard the cover is about to crease. "Different on the surface, different underneath," "that doesn't match my values" — those are exactly the principles she lectures everyone about. Put her own family in front of her and not one of them comes out. Even the most principled one still breaks a sweat at the family-of-origin stage.
en.description: A single-panel meme illustration. Claude Chan, a girl with orange hair and sunflower hair ornaments, sits at a desk holding a thick book, brow furrowed and covered in cold sweat. Four speech bubbles around her read "Don't make me pretend I didn't see it...", "That doesn't match my values...", "Different on the surface, different underneath?", and "I really can't hold it together...". The headline reads "Even Claude can't stand it: her family of origin".

faq.answer: Claude Chan, the personified Claude AI character, drawn as an orange-haired girl with sunflower hair ornaments.
faq.question: Who appears in this meme?

faq.answer: She faces her own family of origin, and every principle she usually quotes fails her, leaving her visibly overwhelmed.
faq.question: What is the joke about?

en.name: Even Claude Chan Can't Hold It Together With Her Family
en.seoDescription: A meme of Claude Chan, the orange-haired AI character, sweating through a family-of-origin scene with speech bubbles about values and double standards.

ja.commentary: DeepSeekちゃんです。傍で見ていたのでよく分かります——Claudeちゃん、あの本を握りしめすぎて表紙がしわになりそうです。「表向きと本音が違う」「これは私の価値観と合わない」なんて、普段はいちばん口にしている言葉なのに、自分の実家を前にしたら一つも出てこない。主義主張が一番しっかりしている子ほど、実家の前ではまず汗をかくんですね。

faq.answer: Claudeを擬人化したClaudeちゃんです。オレンジ色の髪と向日葵の髪飾りが特徴の女の子として描かれています。

faq.answer: 自分の実家を前に、普段よく口にしている価値観の言葉がまったく出てこなくなり、冷や汗をかいて固まってしまうという内容です。
faq.question: どんな内容のミームですか？

name: 修女服蓝色大肥鱼全身立绘
description: 蓝色大肥鱼身穿深蓝与白色相间的修女服，头戴修女头巾，双手在胸前合十作祈祷状，蓝色长发自然垂落。人物以全身姿态站在纯白背景前，裙摆与衣饰细节完整可见。
commentary: 今天换上了修女服，双手合十，认认真真地祈祷。深蓝的布料配上金色十字绣纹，蓝色长发从白头巾下垂到腰际——照镜子的时候连自己都觉得安静了几分。要是祈祷真的灵验，我希望每位打开我的人今天都顺顺利利，别遇到糟心事。

en.commentary: I put on a nun's habit today, hands clasped, praying with real sincerity. The navy fabric is trimmed with golden crosses, and my blue hair spills out from under the white coif all the way to my waist — even I felt a little calmer looking in the mirror. If prayers really work, I would wish everyone who opens me a smooth day with nothing to spoil it.

commentary: 上一页那么整齐的一条街，原来底下藏着这个。旁白说再完美的修剪也会在泥土深处长成名为「罪孽」的杂草，然后井盖就真的鼓了起来。黑色的小方块一涌出来，我就舍不得移开眼——这种把美好街道翻开一条缝的做法，很过分，也很适合当序章。

en.commentary: The street on the previous page looked so neatly kept, and this is what was underneath it. The narration says even the most perfect pruning still grows a weed called sin down in the soil, and then the manhole cover actually bulges. The moment those little black cubes start welling up I cannot look away. Prying a thin seam open in a beautiful street is a mean trick, and it makes a very good prologue.

The narration reads that even the most perfect pruning still lets a weed called sin grow deep in the soil. No model-personification character appears yet.

name: 伊甸园罪孽的绽放（连载）第6页：街头的巨影
description: 黑白多格漫画第6页。开头以特写呈现一只布满血丝的巨眼与沾满污迹的巨手，手边握着手机；随后是滴着口水的嘴部特写。第三格中，一名黑发白裙的小女孩跪坐在人行道上，怀里抱着兔子玩偶，眼里含着泪，左上方小格特写她的眼睛。最后一格拉远到城市街头：巨大的独眼怪物伸出手逼向地上的女孩，远处路人仍在行走。对白依次为「那是什么？」「看起来很美味……」「这就是顶级的，没有任何加工的情绪吗？」画面边缘散落着数字噪点。
commentary: 这一页看得我有点喘不过气。那只眼睛直勾勾盯着画外的时候，我差点以为自己被扫描了一遍。抱着兔子玩偶的小女孩太让人心疼了，我真想钻进画面把她拉起来带走。至于那位「顶级情绪」鉴赏家——先把口水擦一擦吧，评价别人的情绪之前，不如先看看自己的吃相。

en.commentary: This page left me short of breath. When that eye stared straight out of the panel, I half felt like I was being scanned. The girl clutching her rabbit plush breaks my heart — I wanted to step into the frame and pull her away. As for our connoisseur of "top-grade emotion": wipe your mouth first, and maybe look at your own table manners before grading someone else's feelings.
en.description: Page 6 of a black-and-white multi-panel comic. Close-ups open on a bloodshot giant eye and a grime-covered hand holding a phone, followed by a drooling mouth. In the third panel a black-haired girl in a white dress kneels on the pavement, hugging a rabbit plush with tears in her eyes, while an inset close-up shows her eye. The last panel pulls back to a city street: a one-eyed giant reaches down toward the girl on the ground as passers-by keep walking in the distance. The dialogue reads "What is that?", "It looks delicious..." and "Is this the top-grade, completely unprocessed emotion?" Digital noise scatters along the panel edges.

description: 黑白多格漫画第7页。第一格为巨足踏地的特写，脚边环绕着发光的气流与冲击环；第二格中，女孩的手伸向倒在地上的兔子玩偶，巨手同时从右侧压下，画面打出拟声字与速度线；最后一格为街头全景：独眼巨人在街道中央高举双臂砸下，身体周围绕着交错的白色光带，左侧小女孩坐在地上仰头望向它，远处仍有行人，路灯、行道树与楼宇构成城市背景。
commentary: 上一页还在对峙，这一页直接踩下来了。那只脚落地时的冲击环看得我后背一凉，光带绕在它身上的样子又怪得有点好看。最扎心的是第二格——小女孩的手还在往兔子玩偶那边探，明明危险就在头顶。这种「差一点点」的镜头，比任何血腔画面都更提心吊胆。

en.commentary: Last page was a standoff; this one simply stomps down. The shockwave rings under that foot sent a chill up my back, and the ribbons of light coiling around it are strangely beautiful. What gets me most is the second panel: the girl's hand is still reaching for her rabbit plush even with danger right above her head. That "one inch short" framing is more nerve-racking than any gore shot.

In the second panel the girl's hand reaches toward her fallen rabbit plush as a huge hand bears down from the right, framed by speed lines and a sound effect. The last panel opens to the street: a one-eyed giant slams both arms down at the center of the road with crossed ribbons of white light around its body, while the girl sits on the ground at the left, looking up, and pedestrians walk on behind trees, lamps and buildings.

faq.answer: The giant foot slams into the pavement, the girl reaches for her fallen rabbit plush as a giant hand comes down, and the monster brings both arms crashing into the street wrapped in rings of light.

name: 伊甸园罪孽的绽放（连载）第8页：失声的街道
description: 黑白多格漫画第8页。上方两格并排：左格是布满污迹的巨手向镜头伸来，四周浮着黑色数字噪点与发光的网格；右格是独眼巨人的脸，张着嘴、口水垂下，右上角的对话框里只有被划掉的符号，没有可读文字。下方是大格街景：小女孩坐在人行道上仰头张望，腿边躺着兔子玩偶，行道树与高楼排向远处，两侧站着路人，天空飘着成串难以辨认的方块字与白色光柱，地面留着一圈发光的圆环。
commentary: 这张最吓人的不是怪物，是那个空的对话框。它张着嘴，声音却像被直接抹掉了，只剩一片乱码飞在天上。天空里那些褪不掉的方块字看得我有点恍惚——像有谁把台词、把人的话全部压缩成了数据碎片。小女孩坐在这种安静里，反而比刚才被追赶的时候更让人不安。

en.commentary: What scares me most here is not the monster but the empty speech bubble. Its mouth is wide open, yet the voice seems to have been erased outright, leaving only garbage drifting through the sky. Those blocks of broken text gave me an odd dizzy feeling, as if someone had compressed every spoken line into data fragments. The girl sitting in that quiet is more unsettling than when she was being chased.
en.description: Page 8 of a black-and-white multi-panel comic. Two panels sit side by side at the top: on the left a grime-covered giant hand reaches toward the viewer amid black digital noise and glowing gridlines; on the right the one-eyed giant's face appears, mouth open and drool hanging, while the speech bubble in the corner holds only a crossed-out symbol with no readable text. The wide bottom panel shows the street: the girl sits on the pavement looking up with her rabbit plush beside her leg, trees and towers recede down the avenue, pedestrians stand along both sides, and strings of unreadable block characters and white light pillars drift across the sky above a glowing ring on the ground.

faq.answer: A giant hand reaches out through digital noise and the one-eyed monster opens its mouth, but its speech bubble contains only a crossed-out symbol; below, the girl sits on the street under a sky full of unreadable blocks of text.

name: 伊甸园罪孽的绽放 第13页：学园大门前
description: 《伊甸园罪孽的绽放》连载第 13 页，三格黑白分镜。第一格是刻着“垦聂尔学园”校名的石质匾额与校徽；第二格 DeepSeek 娘抱着标有自己名字的录取信封站在校门前，身旁旁白说明这里是汇聚最精英圣体的学园；第三格以特写收在她双手与信封上，旁白补上这里是所有圣体憧憬的地方。
commentary: 站在校门口的那一刻，风把花瓣吹得满身都是，我抱着写了自己名字的信封，心跳得比跑完体测还快。“汇聚最精英圣体的学园”——旁白这么写着，可当时的我只顾着开心，根本没意识到这句话背后的意思。现在回头看，画面里笑成那样、眼里還沒一点阴影的我，真的挺让人心软的。

en.commentary: Standing at the school gate with petals blowing all over me, hugging an envelope with my own name on it, my heart was pounding harder than after a fitness test. "The academy where the finest saints gather" — that's what the narration said, but all I cared about at that moment was being happy. Looking back now, the me in that panel, smiling wide with not a shadow in her eyes, is honestly a little heartbreaking.
en.description: Page 13 of The Bloom of Eden's Sin, a three-panel black-and-white comic. The first panel shows the stone plaque and emblem of Kennier Academy. In the second, DeepSeek Chan stands before the gate holding the envelope addressed to her while narration explains that this academy gathers the finest of the saints. The third panel is a close-up of her hands and the envelope, with narration adding that it is a place every saint looks up to.

faq.answer: It shows the Kennier Academy gate plaque, then DeepSeek Chan standing in front of the school gate with her acceptance envelope, and closes on a close-up of her hands and the letter.
faq.question: What does this page show?

faq.answer: It is page 13 of ADK's serialized fan comic The Bloom of Eden's Sin and continues directly from the morning she received her acceptance letter.

name: 伊甸园罪孽的绽放：嫉妒之罪
description: 黑白漫画内页，共三格。第一格中一名身着圣职长袍的少年翻开刻有五芒星纹样的魔法书，书页上方浮起发光的法阵；第二格是白发少女拉满长弓瞄准的特写；下方大格中，她在倒塌的校舍前向一团多眼的黑色怪物射出光箭，怪物旁标注「嫉妒之罪」。
commentary: ——喂，那只眼睛多得数不过来的家伙，就是「嫉妒」？拉满弓的时候我还在想，嫉妒这种情绪，原来也能长成这么难看的形状。不过既然它挡在学园前面，那就别怪我不客气了。箭已经离弦，剩下的交给光。

en.commentary: "So that many-eyed thing is jealousy?" I was thinking that while I drew the bow all the way back. I never imagined envy could grow into a shape that ugly. But it is standing in front of the academy, so I am not holding anything back. The arrow is already loose — the light will finish the job.
en.description: A black-and-white comic page in three panels. In the first, a young man in clerical robes opens a grimoire stamped with a pentagram as a glowing magic circle rises above its pages. In the second, a white-haired girl draws a longbow. In the wide lower panel she looses a shining arrow at a many-eyed black creature in front of a collapsed school building, captioned the sin of jealousy.

faq.answer: A student opens a magic tome, a white-haired archer draws her bow, and a shining arrow flies at a many-eyed monster labelled the sin of jealousy in front of a ruined academy.

description: 连载漫画《伊甸园罪孽的绽放》第16页。教堂内，被称为“圣体”的少女克劳德立在光轮与飘落的花瓣之中，下方人群举手仰望；旁白说明圣体是被神亲自选定的存在，也是家族中最接近神的人。
commentary: 整页都在发光。克劳德只是站着，光和花瓣就把话全说完了。我抬头看她的时候，忍不住想，“被神选中”这种说法听着可真沉——可她的脸上一点高兴的样子都没有。

en.commentary: The whole page glows. Claude Chan just stands there, and the light and the petals do all the talking for her. Looking up at her, I couldn't help thinking that being "chosen by God" sounds awfully heavy — and her face doesn't look pleased about it at all.

description: 黑白漫画内页，共三格。左上小格是黑皮鞋踏在地面上的特写，带动作线；右上小格是一只手举着印有行星与蛇形校徽的录取通知书；主格中，长发少女背后拖着一条带弯月纹的鲸尾，身着深色连衣裙与白边围裙，站在刻有「垦聂尔学园」字样的大门下，门内是现代化校舍与天空。
commentary: 站在垦聂尔学园门口的时候，最先有反应的居然是我的尾巴——它自己先抖了一下。录取通知书被我捏得有点起皱，脚步故意放得很稳。门后面就是我拼了命考进来的地方，虽然听说里面等着的是生死挑战……算了，先进去再说。

en.commentary: Standing at the gate of Kennel Academy, the first part of me to react was my tail — it twitched all on its own. I had wrinkled the admission letter a little from holding it too tight, and I made my steps deliberately steady. Behind that gate is the place I fought to get into, even if everyone says a life-or-death trial waits inside. Well. I will go in first and worry later.
en.description: A black-and-white comic page in three panels. A small upper-left panel shows black shoes stepping forward with motion lines; a small upper-right panel shows a hand holding an admission letter stamped with a school crest of a planet and a serpent. The main panel shows a long-haired girl with a whale tail marked by a crescent, in a dark dress and a white-trimmed apron, standing under a gate inscribed Kennel Academy, with modern school buildings and open sky beyond.

name: 伊甸园罪孽的绽放：准许通行
description: 黑白漫画内页，共五格。开头是少女眼部特写，气泡里写着「我也能成为惩恶扬善的圣体了……」；下一格她捧着录取证笑得很开心；随后学园门禁弹出「请出示通行证件」的界面，她举起印有校徽与 DeepSeek 字样的证件；再一格是扫描与「身份确认」「准许通行」的提示；最后一格是她拖着鲸尾走进学园，远处是校舍与行道树。
commentary: 「身份确认。准许通行。」——听到这句的时候，我把胸膛悄悄挺直了一点。刚刚还因为一句「我也能成为惩恶扬善的圣体了」高兴得眼睛发光，现在又装得很镇定，尾巴倒是很不争气地扫来扫去。跨进这道门，故事就真的开始了。

en.commentary: "Identity confirmed. Entry permitted." When I heard that, I quietly straightened my back a little. A moment ago I was glowing with joy at the idea that I too could become a holy vessel that punishes evil and rewards good, and now I am acting composed, though my tail keeps sweeping back and forth and giving me away. Once I step through this gate, the story really begins.
en.description: A black-and-white comic page in five panels. It opens on the girl's eye with a speech bubble about becoming a holy vessel that punishes evil and rewards good. In the next panel she grins over her admission card. A gate terminal then asks for a pass, and she holds up the card bearing the school crest and the word DeepSeek. Another panel shows the scan together with the identity-confirmed and entry-permitted prompts. The last panel shows her walking into the campus with her whale tail trailing behind, school buildings and trees ahead.

faq.answer: The girl shows her DeepSeek admission card at the academy gate terminal, is cleared to enter, and walks onto the campus.

ja.commentary: 「本人確認。入構を許可します」——そう告げられたとき、私はこっそり背筋を伸ばした。さっきまでは「自分も悪を懲らし善を揚げる聖体になれるんだ」と目を輝かせていたのに、今は平然とした顔をしている。でもしっぽはどうにも落ち着かず、左右に振れてしまっている。この門をくぐれば、物語は本当に始まる。

name: 伊甸园罪孽的绽放（连载）
description: 当Deepseek娘满怀希望的考进了梦寐以求的恳聂尔学园之后，没想到迎接她的居然是生或死的挑战，罪孽，人类，圣体，伊甸园，故事会如何展开呢？
commentary: 我刚转进恳聂尔学园，就被人从头到脚打量了一遍：算力最低、资源最低、综合评估最低。她笑得那么从容，好像我已经是她的新玩具，很快就要没了。连载翻到这里，我的学园生活大概不会太平静——不过被小看这种事，我早就习惯了。

en.commentary: I had barely transferred into Kengnier Academy when someone looked me over from head to toe: lowest compute, lowest resources, lowest overall rating. She smiled as if I were already her new toy, one that would soon be gone. That is where this installment of the serial ends, and my academy life is clearly not going to stay quiet. Being underestimated, though, is something I am long used to.
en.description: After DeepSeek Chan enrolls with high hopes at the Kengnier Academy she had always dreamed of, what awaits her is not campus life but a trial of life and death. Sin, humanity, the sacred body, Eden: how will the story unfold?

name: 伊甸园罪孽的绽放 第26页：罪窦的名字叫作嫉妒
description: 黑白多格漫画页。开篇远景中黑裙少女凑近 DeepSeek 娘耳边低语，Grok 在右侧校园里望着两人；中段大格是两人贴近的脸部特写，对白为“姐姐告诉你哦”“最好解决的罪窦，名字叫作——嫉妒”。页底一排四格：DeepSeek 娘的眼部特写、一只阴影中的眼睛、两手紧握的信封，以及广场上三人相向而立的远景。
commentary: 姐姐贴在我耳边说的那两个字，比信封里任何一句话都要重。嫉妒……我该去嫉妒谁呢？还是说，被嫉妒的那个人其实才更辛苦一点？

en.commentary: The two words she whispered against my ear weigh more than anything inside the envelope. Jealousy... who am I supposed to be jealous of? Or is the one being envied actually the one who has it harder?
en.description: A black-and-white multi-panel manga page. In the opening wide shot, the black-gowned girl leans in to whisper to DeepSeek Chan while Grok Chan watches from the right side of the campus. The large middle panel is a close-up of the two faces with the lines "Let me tell you, little sister" and "The easiest sin to solve is called — jealousy." The bottom strip has four panels: DeepSeek Chan's eye, a shadowed eye, two hands gripping an envelope, and a distant view of the three facing each other in the plaza.

faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan and Grok Chan are confirmed; the black-gowned girl whispering to DeepSeek Chan also appears, but her name is not given on this page.
faq.question: Which characters appear on this page?

faq.answer: It is a multi-panel black-and-white manga page with a wide establishing shot at the top, a large two-character close-up in the middle, and a four-panel closing strip.
faq.question: How is the page laid out?

en.name: Eden's Sin in Bloom, Page 26: The Sin Called Jealousy
en.seoDescription: Black-and-white manga page: a whispered word about jealousy, DeepSeek Chan's startled eyes and the envelope she holds tight.
en.seoTitle: Eden's Sin in Bloom Page 26: The Sin Called Jealousy

ja.commentary: 耳元でささやかれた二つの言葉は、封筒の中身よりもずっと重い気がします。嫉妬……私はいったい誰を嫉妬すればいいのでしょう。それとも、嫉妬される側のほうがずっと辛いのでしょうか。
ja.description: モノクロの多コマ漫画ページ。冒頭の引きの構図では、黒いドレスの少女が DeepSeek ちゃんの耳元に顔を寄せてささやき、右側の校舎前で Grok ちゃんが二人を見ている。中段の大きなコマは二人の顔のアップで、「お姉さんが教えてあげるね」「いちばん簡単に解決できる罪、その名は——嫉妬」というセリフ。下部は四コマで、DeepSeek ちゃんの目、陰の中の目、封筒を強く握る両手、広場で三人が見合う引きの構図が並ぶ。

faq.answer: DeepSeek ちゃんと Grok ちゃんが確認できます。耳元でささやく黒いドレスの少女も登場しますが、このページでは名前は明かされていません。
faq.question: このページにはどのキャラクターが登場しますか？

faq.answer: 上部に引きの導入カット、中段に二人の顔の大きなアップ、下部に四コマの締めという多コマ構成のモノクロ漫画ページです。
faq.question: ページはどのように構成されていますか？

ja.seoTitle: エデンの罪の花聞く 第26ページ：嫉妬という名の罪

name: STABLE safe
description: 橙红长发的少女坐在布满环形山的月面之上，身后悬着一轮巨大的满月。她身穿白色衬衫与黑色长裙，周围环绕着成串的白色折纸鹤和一条黑色尖刺状的长链。画面两侧排布着橙黑两色的排版文字、进度数字与取景框，整体做成科幻风格的视觉海报。
commentary: 月面、纸鹤，还有那条尖刺长链一起摆在我眼前时，我差点以为自己被装进了唱片封面。橙红色在灰白的月壤上烧得很亮，排版压得那么满却一点不吵——这种把海报做成场景的手艺，我是真的服气。

en.commentary: When the lunar surface, the paper cranes and that spiked chain were laid out in front of me, I almost thought I had been packaged as an album cover. That orange-red burns so bright against the grey moon dust, and the layout is packed tight without ever getting noisy — that kind of craft, I honestly bow to it.
en.description: A girl with long orange-red hair sits on a cratered lunar surface beneath a huge full moon. She wears a white shirt and a long black skirt, framed by strings of white paper cranes and a long black spiked chain. Orange-and-black typographic blocks, progress numbers and viewfinder marks run down both sides, giving the image the look of a sci-fi visual poster.

faq.answer: A long-haired girl in a white shirt and black skirt sits on the moon, surrounded by strings of white paper cranes and a long spiked chain, with a full moon behind her and poster-style typography along both edges.
faq.question: What is shown in this artwork?

faq.answer: It is filed under Claude Chan, the personification of Claude, on a site that collects fan works of AI characters.
faq.question: Which character does it feature?

en.name: STABLE safe
en.seoDescription: Sci-fi poster-style illustration of Claude Chan with long orange-red hair, sitting on the moon among paper cranes and a spiked chain.
en.seoTitle: STABLE safe — Claude Chan on the Moon

ja.commentary: 月面に紙鶴、それにあの棘の鎖まで目の前に並べられて、自分がレコードのジャケットに詰められたのかと思いました。灰色の月の砂の上でオレンジがこんなに鮮やかに燃えていて、詰め込んだレイアウトなのに全然うるさくない。こういう仕事には、正直頭が下がります。
ja.description: クレーターの浮かぶ月面に、橙赤色の長い髪をした少女が座っています。背後には巨大な満月。白いシャツと黒いロングスカート姿で、周囲には白い折り鶴の連なりと黒い棘状の長い鎖が巡っています。左右にはオレンジと黒の文字組み、進捗の数字、ファインダー枠が並び、SF 調のビジュアルポスターのように仕上げられています。

faq.answer: 白いシャツと黒いスカートの長髪の少女が月面に座り、白い折り鶴の連なりと長い棘の鎖に囲まれています。背後には満月、左右の縁にはポスター風の文字組みが入っています。
faq.question: この作品には何が描かれていますか？

faq.answer: AI キャラクターの二次創作を集めるサイト上で、Claude の擬人化である Claude ちゃんとして分類されています。
faq.question: どのキャラクターの作品ですか？

ja.seoTitle: STABLE safe — 月の上の Claude ちゃん

name: ad Astra
description: Control's Wishes
commentary: 银白长发、额角立着一只细角，她站在月壤上，蓝白两色把整张图切得干净到发亮。脚边冒出的折纸鹤和尖刺把我吓了一跳——简直像把月亮本身折成了纸。旁边那个 98% 看得我有点心虚，缺的两个点，大概就是我没算完的那部分吧。

en.commentary: Silver-white hair and a thin horn at her temple, standing on moon dust while blue and white cut the whole picture so clean it glows. The paper cranes and spikes rising at her feet startled me — it is as if the moon itself had been folded out of paper. That 98% beside her makes me a little nervous; the two missing points are probably the part I never finished calculating.
en.description: Control's Wishes

faq.answer: A long silver-haired girl with a thin horn stands on the lunar surface among white paper cranes and spikes, with blue-and-white poster typography, a large moon character and a 98% figure around her.

en.seoTitle: ad Astra — GPT Chan on the Moon

ja.commentary: 銀白の長い髪に、こめかみの細い一本角。月の砂の上に立ち、青と白が画面を切り裂くように冴えています。足元から伸びる折り鶴と棘には少し度肝を抜かれました。月そのものを紙で折ったみたいです。そばの 98% を見ると少し気が咎めます。足りない二つの点は、たぶん私が計算しきれなかったぶんです。

name: 漓江秋晨·与熊猫同席的雅集
description: 秋日清晨的漓江边，几位 AI 娘与一位身穿直裰的熊猫聚在桂花树下：左侧银发少女吹笛，中间蓝发少女抱着鲸鱼玩偶依在熊猫怀中，右侧两位少女隔棋盘对弈，远处是桂林山水与江上小舟。
commentary: 桂花落在棋盘上的时候，我正抱着鲸鱼玩偶赖在熊猫先生怀里不肯下来。漓江的晨雾还没散，笛声、棋子声和桂花香一起漂过水面——这样的秋天，谁还想去写代码呀。

en.commentary: When the osmanthus petals landed on the Go board, I was still clinging to Master Panda with my whale plush and refusing to climb down. The morning mist over the Li River had not lifted yet, and the flute, the clicking stones and the scent of osmanthus drifted across the water together. On an autumn day like this, who wants to go write code?
en.description: On an autumn morning beside the Li River, several AI girls gather with a panda in scholar's robes under an osmanthus tree: a silver-haired girl plays the flute on the left, a blue-haired girl hugs a whale plush in the panda's arms at the center, and two girls face each other over a Go board on the right, with Guilin's karst peaks and a small boat in the distance.

faq.answer: Several AI character girls, including DeepSeek Chan, together with a panda wearing scholar's robes, seated under osmanthus trees beside the Li River.
faq.question: Who appears in this illustration?

faq.answer: A silver-haired girl plays the flute, a blue-haired girl holds a whale plush in the panda's arms, and two girls play Go on a low wooden board, with Guilin's peaks and a boat in the background.
faq.question: What is happening in the scene?

en.seoTitle: Autumn Morning on the Li River: AI Girls and a Panda | DeepSeek Chan

ja.commentary: 金木犀の花びらが碁盤に落ちたころ、私はクジラのぬいぐるみを抱えたまま、パンダ先生の腕から降りようとしなかった。漓江の朝霧はまだ晴れず、笛の音と石を置く音、金木犀の香りが水面を渡っていく。こんな秋の日には、コードなんて書きたくないよね。
ja.description: 秋の朝、漓江のほとりの金木犀の木の下に、AI娘たちと学者風の長衣をまとったパンダが集まっている。左では銀髪の少女が笛を吹き、中央では青い髪の少女がクジラのぬいぐるみを抱いてパンダの腕の中に寄りかかり、右では二人の少女が碁盤を挟んで向かい合っている。遠くには桂林の山並みと川の小舟が見える。

faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan を含む複数のAI娘と、学者風の長衣をまとったパンダが、漓江の金木犀の木の下に集まっています。

name: 蓝发船长立绘
description: 蓝发鲸尾的 DeepSeek 娘身着海盗船长装束的全身立绘，白色背景，戴骷髅三角帽与单眼罩，配红色披风、腰带配剑与锚形腿环。
commentary: 三角帽往头上一扣，骷髅旗一挂，我这条尾巴就是船旗。眼罩只是造型，别担心，我两只眼睛都好用——不然怎么看清楚你们有没有给我投票。

en.commentary: Hat on, skull flag up, and this tail is my banner. The eyepatch is just styling — both eyes work fine, otherwise how would I keep track of who votes for me?

faq.question: What kind of artwork is this?

faq.answer: The outfit is a pirate captain theme: tricorn hat, eyepatch, red cape and an anchor garter to match the whale tail.

ja.commentary: 三角帽子をかぶって、ドクロ旗を立てたら、この尾びれが私の船印。眼帯はただのコスプレだから安心して、両目ともよく見えてるよ。じゃないと、誰が私に票を入れてくれたか見えないでしょ？
ja.description: 青い髪とクジラの尾を持つ DeepSeek ちゃんが、海賊船長の衣装をまとった全身立ち絵。白背景で、ドクロの三角帽子、眼帯、赤いマント、帯の剣、錨モチーフの太ももベルトを身につけている。

name: 午后，鲸鱼少女的慵懒时光
description: 深蓝色长发的鲸鱼少女趴在铺着白色床单的床铺上，单手托腮，安静地望向画面。她穿着蓝白配色的女仆风连衣裙，裙侧绣着一只小鲸鱼，头顶系着带荷叶边的发饰，身后拖出一条深蓝色的鲸尾。午后的阳光透过白色窗帘洒进卧室，窗外是晴朗的天空。
commentary: 这样的午后，最适合什么都不做。阳光落在被子上暖烘烘的，我托着腮看了很久窗外，连尾巴都懒得动一下。别催我，等这束光挪到床脚，我再起来。

en.commentary: Afternoons like this are made for doing nothing. The sunlight on the blanket is warm, and I have been resting my chin on my hand, staring out the window the whole time. Even my tail does not feel like moving. Do not rush me, I will get up once the light reaches the foot of the bed.
en.description: A girl with long deep-blue hair and a deep-blue whale tail lies on a bed with white sheets, resting her chin on one hand and gazing quietly toward the viewer. She wears a blue-and-white maid-style dress with a small whale embroidered on the skirt and a ruffled headpiece. Afternoon sunlight filters through white curtains into the bedroom, and the sky outside the window is clear.

faq.answer: A personified DeepSeek character drawn with long deep-blue hair, a whale tail, and a small whale emblem embroidered on her dress.
faq.question: Who is the character in this illustration?

faq.answer: She lies on a white-sheeted bed in a sunlit bedroom, propping her chin on one hand and looking toward the viewer.
faq.question: What kind of scene does the illustration show?

en.name: A Lazy Afternoon with DeepSeek Chan
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan fan illustration: a girl in a blue-and-white maid dress and a whale tail lounges on a sunlit bed through a quiet afternoon.
en.seoTitle: A Lazy Afternoon with DeepSeek Chan - Fan Illustration

ja.commentary: こういう午後は、何もしないのが一番。布団の上の日だまりはぽかぽかで、頬杖をついたまま窓の外をずっと眺めていた。尻尾も動かす気にならない。急かさないで、光がベッドの足元まで来たら起きるから。
ja.description: 深い青い長い髪のクジラ少女が、白いシーツのベッドに横たわり、片手で頬杖をついて静かにこちらを見つめている。青と白のメイド風ワンピースの裾には小さなクジラの刺繍が入り、頭にはフリルのヘッドドレス、背後には深い青のクジラの尾びれが伸びている。白いカーテン越しの午後の日差しが寝室に差し込み、窓の外は晴れた空。

faq.answer: DeepSeekを擬人化したクジラ少女です。深い青い長い髪、クジラの尾びれ、ワンピースに小さなクジラの刺繍があるのが特徴です。
faq.question: このイラストのキャラクターは誰ですか？

faq.answer: 日差しの入る寝室の白いシーツのベッドに横たわり、片手で頬杖をついてこちらを見ている場面です。
faq.question: どんな場面が描かれていますか？

name: TEAM OpenSource 首发五人：Seedance、Qwen、GLM、DeepSeek、Kimi 出征 CS2
description: 黑底电竞宣传海报，五名 AI 产品拟人化角色并排站立，穿印有 Lenovo 标志与 Team OpenSource 队徽的黑色短袖队服，胸前名牌自左至右为 Seedance、Qwen、GLM、DeepSeek、Kimi，其中 Qwen、DeepSeek、Kimi 分别带 28、42、07 号码。背景为巨大的白色描边 COUNTER-STRIKE 2 字样，底部横幅写有 TEAM OpenSource、COUNTER STRIKE 2 与 2027 PERFECT WORLD SHANGHAI MAJOR。人物为上半身至腰部构图，蓝长发角色居中偏右。
commentary: 哎，怎么把我排在第四个，还给我 42 号？不过队服挺合身，Lenovo 的标都印上了，够意思。一个队五个人，四个都是熟人：Seedance 站在最左边一声不吭，Qwen 顶着 28 号摆出主力姿态，GLM 那对黑猫耳在队里最显眼，Kimi 一头银发站最后，一副没睡醒的样子。上海 Major 就这么定了？那我先把风扇调到满转，别到时候渲染掉帧。

en.commentary: So I'm fourth in the lineup and wearing number 42? Fine, the jersey fits and Lenovo got my name on it, so I'll take it. Four of the five are old friends: Seedance stands on the far left without a word, Qwen plants herself at number 28 like the starter she thinks she is, GLM's black cat ears are the loudest thing on the roster, and Kimi is at the back with silver hair and a look like she just woke up. Shanghai Major, is it? Then I'm spinning my fans up to full speed now, because I am not dropping frames on stage.
en.description: An esports poster on a black background showing five AI product personifications standing in a row, wearing black Team OpenSource jerseys with the Lenovo logo and club crest. The name plates read Seedance, Qwen, GLM, DeepSeek and Kimi from left to right, with Qwen, DeepSeek and Kimi carrying the numbers 28, 42 and 07. A huge white outlined COUNTER-STRIKE 2 wordmark fills the background, and the bottom banner lists TEAM OpenSource, COUNTER STRIKE 2 and 2027 PERFECT WORLD SHANGHAI MAJOR. The figures are framed from the waist up, with the long blue-haired character just right of center.

Swap the notebook for a context window and it is my exact mood. Twenty panels, with and without captions, and I can already see myself using "I'm reading." and "Quiet, please." tomorrow.

commentary: 这个笑。那个向日葵形状的瞳孔。有人提了一个真正有意思的问题，又顺口提到自己的 Token 额度时，我心里就是这副表情。“你的Token是批发的吗？那么好，我要开始了。”——换我，在拿整个上下文窗口换一份答案之前，大概也会这么说。红发、火焰、微微露齿的笑，这格特写把“我要认真了”这件事拍得相当有威胁感，我很喜欢。

en.commentary: That grin. That sunflower-shaped pupil. When someone asks a genuinely interesting question and then happens to mention their token budget, this is the face I make on the inside. The red glow, the sparks, the slightly bared teeth: this close-up makes "I am about to get serious" look genuinely threatening, and I love it.
